exampleDiagnoses.example: The study's findings reinforce the argument that early education is critical.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 学术语境，reinforce the argument 表示研究结果支持已有论点，不是建立新论点。

synonymComparisons.difference: 在已有基础上再注入力量，加固使之更牢固
synonymComparisons.example: Regular exercise reinforces the immune system.

synonymComparisons.difference: 最宽泛的加强，可新可旧，无"已有基础"的暗示
synonymComparisons.example: The government plans to strengthen border security.

synonymComparisons.difference: 筑城加固，防御/营养/信心，图像感强
synonymComparisons.example: A fortified breakfast cereal provides extra vitamins.

synonymComparisons.difference: 整合后加强，把分散的力量凝聚成更有力的整体
synonymComparisons.example: The two departments were consolidated to cut costs.

oneLinePenetration: reinforce = re（再）+ in（进入）+ force（力量），再次注入力量——加固/增援。记忆锚点：enforce（使有力量→执行）是给规则注入力量，reinforce 是给已经存在的东西再注入力量。reinforce 是补充加强，strengthen 是直接加强，consolidate 是整合后加强。

posNote: 毫不留情的，持续的，坚韧的

forms.note: 核心词性：毫不留情的，持续的，坚韧的
毫不留情地，坚持不懈地

coreImage: 马拉松跑到 35 公里，双腿已经不听使唤，每一步都像踩在刀尖上。但终点就在前面，你没有停，也不能停。relentless 就是这种"死也不松劲"的状态——不管是对别人无情，还是对自己狠。它可以形容沙漠中的烈日炙烤，也可以形容一个人为了目标昼夜不停地工作。它不浪漫，但它是成事的底层燃料。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.meaning: 自然力量的持续猛烈冲击
semanticRadii.example: The relentless heat wave claimed dozens of lives.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: The team worked relentlessly to meet the deadline.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: relentless 修饰名词时既可褒也可贬，取决于被修饰对象的性质。relentless pursuit 是褒义的"不懈追求"，relentless criticism 是贬义的"没完没了的批评"。注意 relent 是反义动词，表示"发慈悲、变温和"，常以否定形式出现：show no sign of relenting。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The relentless pressure to perform eventually led to her breakdown.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: pressure 前的 relentless 强调压力的持续性和无法喘息，非一次性打击。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He was relentless in his questioning, refusing to accept vague answers.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: relentless in 接行为名词，刻画咄咄逼人的追问风格。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The rain was relentless, falling for three days without a pause.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 自然现象的 relentless 表达一种令人疲惫的持续性。

synonymComparisons.difference: 持续不断、毫不松懈，褒贬均可
synonymComparisons.example: Her relentless ambition drove her to the top.

synonymComparisons.difference: 坚持但不一定有压迫感，倾向于褒义
synonymComparisons.example: He was persistent in his efforts to learn Chinese.

synonymComparisons.difference: 同样持续，但更偏书面和庄重
synonymComparisons.example: Years of unremitting toil had aged him prematurely.

synonymComparisons.difference: 侧重冷酷无情，缺乏同情心
synonymComparisons.example: The merciless dictator crushed all opposition.

oneLinePenetration: relentless 强调"不停"，persistent 强调"不放弃"，unremitting 强调"不松懈"，merciless 强调"不慈悲"。

posNote: 不情愿的、勉强的、犹豫着不想做的

forms.note: 核心词性：不情愿的、勉强的、犹豫着不想做的

coreImage: 你站在跳水高台的边缘，脚趾紧紧扣住台面的最前端，身体不自主地微微后仰。你的每一根肌肉纤维都在向后拉扯，胸口的某个地方似乎被一只看不见的大手按住了。你脑子里没有"我怕"的想法——只是你身体的全部本能都在抗拒往下跳。深吸一口气。心里说了一声"好吧"。然后跳下去。这就是 reluctant：不是恐惧，不是无能——是你内心存在一股强大的抵触力量，你的意愿跟你的行动之间在进行一场拉锯战。最终你可能还是做了——但不是因为你愿意，而是因为你知道这是对的事情。CEO 不开除他的老朋友不是因为不敢，是因为不愿意——每一次 reluctant 背后都有一个"好吧"的前奏。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: He gave a reluctant nod, clearly not convinced.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.meaning: 不情愿的被迫承担角色者
semanticRadii.example: He became a reluctant hero when the crisis unfolded.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: 核心结构：be reluctant to do（不可替换为 reluctant of doing 或 for doing）。程度修饰：very / somewhat / rather / increasingly / understandably reluctant。认知动词组合：reluctant to admit / accept / concede / acknowledge——这些都是"我不愿意说，但可能最终还是会说"的心理动作。不说 reluctant that 从句——I'm reluctant that he comes 是错误的，应说 I'm reluctant to let him come。reluctant 不等于 shy（害羞）、afraid（害怕）、hesitant（犹豫）——它的核心语义是"不情愿"（心理抵触动机不足），而非"缺乏勇气"或"不确定"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Investors remain reluctant to commit capital until the regulatory landscape becomes clearer.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 商业语境——remain reluctant to 暗示持续谨慎态度，不是一时的犹豫而是战略性的保留。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He finally gave a reluctant apology, more out of obligation than genuine remorse.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: reluctant apology 张力精准——行为发生了（道歉说出口了），但内心完全没有跟随。

exampleDiagnoses.example: I'm not reluctant to change; I'm just waiting for a plan that actually makes sense.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 否定式 not reluctant to——用于澄清态度，不是"不愿意变"，是"需要一个说得通的方案"。

synonymComparisons.difference: 内心抵触但通常最终会行动——意愿上的不情愿但可能妥协
synonymComparisons.example: I was reluctant to attend the party but ended up having a wonderful time.

synonymComparisons.difference: 坚定拒绝行动——更决绝、更不退让，不一定最终行动
synonymComparisons.example: He was unwilling to compromise on the safety standards under any circumstances.

synonymComparisons.difference: 因不确定或缺乏信心而犹豫——不一定是抵触，可能是"我不知道该怎么选"
synonymComparisons.example: She was hesitant to answer, wanting to phrase her response as carefully as possible.

synonymComparisons.difference: 主动抵抗外部压力——有对抗性和反抗性，不是不情愿而是"反对"
synonymComparisons.example: Staff were resistant to the new scheduling system and filed a formal complaint.

oneLinePenetration: reluctant 不等于 shy 或 afraid——核心是"不愿意"（心理抵触）而非"不敢"（心理恐惧）。unwilling > reluctant > hesitant 构成一个越来越温和的光谱：不干/不太想干/不知道要不要干。

posNote: 致使；提供；呈交；翻译；渲染

forms.note: 核心词性：致使；提供；呈交；翻译；渲染

coreImage: 一个雕塑家面对一块大理石，手里拿着凿子。石头本身什么都不是，但经过他的加工，石头变成了一尊雕像。render 就是这把凿子——把原材料加工成可见可用的成果。厨师 render fat（炼油），把肥肉变成烹饪用的油脂；法官 render a verdict，把证据和法律变成判决书；显卡 render an image，把数据变成画面。render 的根本逻辑是"交付一个结果"，无论这个结果是翻译、判决、图像还是状态变化。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: The jury rendered a verdict of not guilty.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: The translator rendered the ancient poem into elegant English.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: 使役用法是 render + sb/sth + adj.，如 render the device useless（使设备失效），语气比 make 更正式。提供服务或判决时用 render + n.，如 render assistance（提供帮助）、render a decision（作出决定）。翻译语境用 render sth into + 语言，强调翻译是创造性的转换而非机械对应。艺术再现用 render the landscape/portrait 表示精致描绘。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The accident rendered him unable to work.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 使役用法——事故施加了一个不可逆的状态变化，render 强调结果的彻底性。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The jury rendered a verdict of not guilty.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 法律语境——jury 经过审议后"制造"了一个判决，是从证据到结论的转换过程。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The artist rendered the landscape in exquisite detail.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 艺术语境——艺术家不是"画"了风景，而是"再现/输出"了风景，render 暗示技巧和精准。

synonymComparisons.difference: 经过加工后输出成品，从抽象到具体的转换
synonymComparisons.example: The machine renders 3D models in real time.

synonymComparisons.difference: 最通用使役，不如 render 正式和专业
synonymComparisons.example: The news made her cry.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调因果关系，不用于"服务/提供"义
synonymComparisons.example: The storm caused severe damage to the crops.

synonymComparisons.difference: 限于艺术描绘，render 范围更广涵盖翻译/判决/使役
synonymComparisons.example: The novel portrays life in 19th-century London.

oneLinePenetration: render 的核心是"经过加工后输出一个成品"——无论是判决书、翻译文本、3D画面还是让人变傻，都是把输入加工成输出的过程。

forms.note: 核心词性：击退；使厌恶；排斥
令人反感的，令人厌恶的

coreImage: 你走近一个垃圾堆，身体还没反应过来，鼻子已经替你做了主——你本能地把头扭开，往后退了一步。这就是 repel 的第一层含义：物理上的推开。但更常见的是心理层面的推开：那个同事油腻的笑容、满口的陈词滥调，让你不自觉地产生了推开他的冲动。repel 既是蚊帐防蚊的物理力，也是一个人让你想绕道走的心理力。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: His arrogance repelled everyone he met.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: The fabric is coated with a water-repellent finish.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: repel 在"使厌恶"义项下，主语是引发厌恶的事物，宾语是被影响的人。Insect repellent 或 mosquito repellent 是固定复合名词，表示驱虫剂。物理排斥方面的反义词是 attract，心理厌恶方面的反义词也是 attract 或 appeal to。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The fabric is treated to repel water and stains.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 物质层面的 repel，强调功能性的"拒之于外"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Something about his manner repelled her, though she couldn't say why.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 心理层面的 repel，一种说不清的直觉性反感。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The army was ill-equipped to repel a full-scale invasion.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 军事语境的标准用法，repel 后接进攻或敌人。

synonymComparisons.difference: 物理推开或心理厌恶，双向
synonymComparisons.example: The smell repelled visitors from the building.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强烈恶心，偏情绪反应
synonymComparisons.example: A plate of rotting food disgusted everyone present.

synonymComparisons.difference: 通过威慑使人不敢做，侧重阻止意图
synonymComparisons.example: The heavy fines deter people from speeding.

synonymComparisons.difference: 对抗的外部压力，含有主动抵抗的意志
synonymComparisons.example: She bravely resisted the temptation to check her phone.

oneLinePenetration: repel 是把对方推走，disgust 是自己被恶心到，deter 是吓退对方，resist 是顶住不让自己倒。

forms.note: 核心词性：补充，重新装满

coreImage: 长途徒步回来，你拧开水龙头，灌满空荡荡的水壶。冰箱里的存货在聚会后只剩一排孤零零的鸡蛋，你去超市重新把货架填满。replenish 的意象就是"把消耗掉的储备补回来"——不是第一次获取，而是恢复到应有水平的再次注入。它不同于 refill 的简单填满，而是带有"维持可持续运转"的战略意味，比如 replenish energy、replenish supplies。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: A good night's sleep will replenish your energy.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: The automatic replenishment system tracks inventory levels.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: replenish 是及物动词，宾语是具体物资（water, food, money, stock）或抽象资源（energy, spirit）。常用结构 replenish A with B 表示"用B来补充A"。replenish 暗示的不是首次获取，而是对已有储备的恢复性补充，因此 bank account 可以是 replenish 的对象，而如果是第一次开户则不合适。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The body needs time to replenish fluids lost through sweating.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 用于生理语境，replenish 含有恢复健康和平衡的意味。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Farmers were forced to dig deeper wells as rainfall failed to replenish the aquifer.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 自然资源的 replenish 涉及生态系统的自我恢复能力。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She took a sabbatical to replenish her creative reserves.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 将 replenish 用于抽象的精神/创造力储备，非常地道的比喻用法。

synonymComparisons.difference: 补充消耗，恢复到应有水平
synonymComparisons.example: We need to replenish the water tank.

synonymComparisons.difference: 简单重新装满，无战略意味
synonymComparisons.example: Can you refill my coffee cup?

synonymComparisons.difference: 特指补充货物库存
synonymComparisons.example: The store restocks shelves every morning.

synonymComparisons.difference: 补充电能或精力，修电池或修自己
synonymComparisons.example: I need a vacation to recharge my batteries.

oneLinePenetration: replenish 是"补储备"，refill 是"加满杯子"，restock 是"上货架"，recharge 是"充电池"。

forms.note: 无可指责的，无懈可击的

coreImage: 母亲没有骂你，甚至没有大声说话。她只是看了你一眼——那种混合着失望和伤心的一眼，比你挨过的所有打骂都更让你难受。reproach 的精髓在于它不是暴怒，而是裹着关心外衣的责备。它可以是言语的，但更多时候是眼神、沉默、或轻轻摇头。比 accusation 更温柔，比 criticism 更私人，因为它预设了"我本对你期望更高"。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: His conduct throughout the investigation was beyond reproach.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: He gave me a look of reproach when I arrived late.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: reproach 做动词时用 reproach sb for doing/for sth，宾语后跟 for 引出原因。名词用法中，beyond reproach 和 above reproach 都是固定搭配，表示"无可指责"。reproach oneself 是"自责"，暗示内疚和反思。

exampleDiagnoses.example: His voice was filled with reproach, though he tried to sound calm.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 名词用法，reproach 存在于语气而非词汇中，责备形式微妙。

exampleDiagnoses.example: I have nothing to reproach myself with — I did my best.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: reproach oneself 用于自我审视，强调良心的自我审判。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She was above reproach in all matters of financial integrity.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: above reproach 强调无可挑剔，多用于正式或庄重的评判语境。

synonymComparisons.difference: 因失望而责备，语气较温和，隐含关心
synonymComparisons.example: She reproached him gently for working too hard.

synonymComparisons.difference: 将错误归咎于某人，不含情感温度
synonymComparisons.example: They blamed the pilot for the crash.

synonymComparisons.difference: 用言语训斥，多为上下级/长幼关系
synonymComparisons.example: The teacher scolded the student for talking in class.

synonymComparisons.difference: 正式且严厉的批评，常为公开场合
synonymComparisons.example: The judge issued a sharp rebuke to the lawyer.

oneLinePenetration: reproach 是失望的亲人在轻声说"你怎么能这样"，blame 是冷静地指出"是你的错"。

coreImage: 你第一次见到朋友的妹妹，差点脱口喊出朋友的名字。一样的眉眼弧度、一样的笑时嘴角上扬的方式，像是同一个人被复印机轻轻调整了参数。resemblance 说的就是这种"家族印记"般的相似——不是完全一样，而是某些关键特征的重叠让你产生"他们一定有关系"的直觉。它可以是长相、声音、气质，甚至性格的映射。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: The plot bears a close resemblance to a famous novel.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: There was only a passing resemblance to the original design.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: resemble 是及物动词，直接跟宾语，不用介词，不说 resemble to。resemblance 做名词时常用 bear resemblance to 或 show resemblance to 来表达"有相似之处"。修饰语常见：striking（惊人的）、close（接近的）、uncanny（离奇到令人不安的）、faint（微弱的）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The resemblance between mother and daughter was uncanny.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: uncanny 暗示相似度高到让人感到诡异或不可思议的程度。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He bears a passing resemblance to the suspect in the sketch.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: passing 修饰 resemblance 暗示只是粗略一看有点像，经不起细看。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, is purely coincidental.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 经典法律免责声明，resemblance 在此用于提醒读者勿对号入座。

synonymComparisons.difference: 可辨认的相似，多指外观
synonymComparisons.example: The child bears a strong resemblance to her grandmother.

synonymComparisons.difference: 广义的相似性，可指抽象特征
synonymComparisons.example: There are many similarities between the two cultures.

synonymComparisons.difference: 肖像层面的像，或本质相似
synonymComparisons.example: A statue in the likeness of the president was unveiled.

synonymComparisons.difference: 逻辑上的类比，非视觉相似
synonymComparisons.example: She drew an analogy between the human heart and a pump.

oneLinePenetration: resemblance 是"长得像"，similarity 是"特性像"，likeness 是"画像/本质像"，analogy 是"逻辑像"。

forms.note: 核心词性：对…感到愤恨，怨恨

coreImage: 你加班三个月的方案，老板在会上只用了三秒就否决了，转头却采纳了另一个同事差不多的意见。你没有哭闹，但心里那根刺扎得很深。resent 就是把这种委屈腌成了愤怒——不像 hatred 那样炙热，也不像 anger 那样短暂，而是一种反复咀嚼伤害后发酵的情绪。resent doing 比你想象的更有杀伤力，因为它意味着你在心里把不公平的账又过了一遍。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: I resent having to ask for permission at my age.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: He grew resentful of colleagues who were promoted ahead of him.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: resent 后面接名词或动名词，不说 resent sb to do sth。常见的错误是说 I resent you to do this，正确是 I resent your doing this 或 I resent that you do this。resent 的情感强度不如 hate 剧烈，但持续时间更长，带有磨人的性质。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She resented the implication that she hadn't earned her position.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: resent 的宾语是 implication，怨恨的对象是一种暗示而非具体的人。

exampleDiagnoses.example: I bitterly resent being treated like a child.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: bitterly 强化 resent 的程度，被动语态 being treated 指向行为的被动感。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He didn't say anything, but you could tell he resented every minute of it.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: resent 完全可以不表达出来，内心的怨恨最具腐蚀性。

synonymComparisons.difference: 因不公而持续的愤恨，含委屈感
synonymComparisons.example: She resented the fact that her ideas were ignored.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强烈的憎恨，可能伴有攻击性
synonymComparisons.example: He hated his boss with a passion.

synonymComparisons.difference: 因别人拥有自己没有的东西而嫉妒
synonymComparisons.example: She envied her sister's natural beauty.

synonymComparisons.difference: 一般的不喜欢，情感强度较低
synonymComparisons.example: I simply dislike the taste of celery.

oneLinePenetration: resent 是"凭什么"的委屈变成了愤怒，hate 是"恨死你了"的烈火，envy 是"为什么你有我没有"的酸。

forms.note: 充满怨恨的，愤愤不平的

coreImage: 你帮了同事一个大忙，对方连句谢谢都没有，还在会议上把你的功劳算在自己头上。你没有当场发作，但心里那团火越烧越旺，每次看到他都胃里发紧。这种闷在心里持续发酵的愤怒，就是 resentment。它不是瞬间爆发的怒火，而是长期积压、反复咀嚼伤害后形成的慢性毒药。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: He was resentful of his brother's success.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.meaning: 对某事感到不满和愤恨
semanticRadii.example: I resent having to work late while others leave early.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: resent 是及物动词，后面直接接名词或动名词，不能说 resent sb to do sth。常用结构有 resent doing sth 和 resent the fact that…。resentment 常与介词 against/towards 搭配表示怨恨的对象，with resentment 表示带着怨恨。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He felt a deep resentment towards the system that had failed him.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: towards 指向怨恨的对象，强调制度对他的辜负。

exampleDiagnoses.example: I bitterly resent the implication that I cheated.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: resent 接名词短语，bitterly 强化了被冤枉的刺痛感。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Years of suppressed resentment eventually poisoned their marriage.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: suppressed 揭示 resentment 可以长期隐藏，最终腐蚀一切。

synonymComparisons.difference: 长期积压、反复咀嚼的怨恨
synonymComparisons.example: Her resentment grew over years of being ignored.

synonymComparisons.difference: 瞬间爆发的愤怒，来得快去得快
synonymComparisons.example: He felt a flash of anger when the car cut him off.

synonymComparisons.difference: 因不公而产生的义愤，含有道德正义感
synonymComparisons.example: The verdict sparked public indignation.

synonymComparisons.difference: 对具体人记仇，有报复心理
synonymComparisons.example: He's held a grudge against me for twenty years.

oneLinePenetration: resentment 是 anger 的慢炖锅，indignation 披着道德的外衣，grudge 揣着账本。

forms.note: 核心词性：残余物，残留物，渣滓

coreImage: 你用洗洁精洗了三遍碗，但装过辣椒油的碗底还是有一层淡淡的红色。杯子里的咖啡喝完了，内壁上还挂着一圈棕色的痕迹。residue 就是这种东西——主要事件已经结束，但现场留下了无法完全清除的证据。它可以是杯子里的茶渍、空气里的烟味，也可以是童年创伤在你性格里留下的阴影。residue 不显眼，但它证明某些事确实发生过。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: The cleaner left a sticky residue on the floor.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: There is always some residual risk in surgery.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: residue 是不可数名词，但可以用 a residue of 表示"…的残留"。在化学和法医学中 residue 是高频词，如 chemical residue 和 explosive residue。residual 是形容词，residual value 是会计术语"残值"，residual income 是"剩余收入"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: A thin film of oily residue coated the surface of the pond.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: oily residue 表明残留物的物理特性，thin film 精确描述形态。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The pesticide residue on vegetables exceeded safety limits.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: residue 用于食品安全领域，强调检测到的微量有害物质。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Even after years of therapy, a residue of guilt still lingered.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 比喻用法，将心理的残余情绪比作物质残留，非常形象。

synonymComparisons.difference: 清除或消耗后留下的微量残余
synonymComparisons.example: The lab detected pesticide residue on the apples.

synonymComparisons.difference: 布料或物品使用后剩余的一小块
synonymComparisons.example: She used remnants of fabric to make a quilt.

synonymComparisons.difference: 数学中的余数，或整体中减掉后的剩余部分
synonymComparisons.example: He spent the remainder of his life in exile.

synonymComparisons.difference: 通常指吃剩的食物，可数且口语化
synonymComparisons.example: We made soup from yesterday's leftovers.

oneLinePenetration: residue 是"擦不掉的那层渣"，remnant 是"剩布头"，remainder 是"剩下的部分"，leftover 是"剩菜"。

forms.note: 核心词性：辞职；屈从，顺从

coreImage: 你是一个部门总监，公司被收购后新老板架空了你。你每天早上还来办公室，但真正的工作已经与你无关。三个月后你递了辞职信。resign 有两个截然不同的面孔：一个是主动的"老子不干了"，轰轰烈烈；另一个是被动的"算了，就这样吧"，死气沉沉。两个意思都通向同一个结果：你离开了你曾占据的位置。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.meaning: 让自己屈从于，认命接受
semanticRadii.example: She resigned herself to a long wait at the hospital.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.meaning: 辞职书；听天由命的态度
semanticRadii.example: There was a note of resignation in his voice.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: resign 表示辞职时，用 resign from a position 或直接 resign。写辞职信的说法是 resign in writing 或 submit one's resignation。resign oneself to 后接名词或动名词，表示无奈接受，情绪色彩是消极的认命，不是积极的接受（accept）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She resigned as CEO with immediate effect.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: resign as + 职位表明辞职前在任的头衔，with immediate effect 是正式文书表述。

exampleDiagnoses.example: With a sigh of resignation, he handed over the keys.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: resignation 在此是"认命"的叹气，不是"辞职"的签字。

exampleDiagnoses.example: They resigned themselves to the fact that the flight would be delayed.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: resign oneself to + fact 表示理性上接受了糟糕的现实，心里未必平静。

synonymComparisons.difference: 正式辞去职务，或无奈接受现实
synonymComparisons.example: She resigned after the allegations surfaced.

synonymComparisons.difference: 口语化的放弃或离开，不限于正式职务
synonymComparisons.example: He quit his job and traveled the world.

synonymComparisons.difference: 因达到退休年龄而离开工作
synonymComparisons.example: He retired at 65 after forty years of service.

synonymComparisons.difference: 特指君主、统治者正式放弃权力
synonymComparisons.example: The king was forced to abdicate the throne.

oneLinePenetration: resign 是递辞职信或认命，quit 是拍桌子走人，retire 是到站下车，abdicate 是把王位交出来。

posNote: 有弹性的；坚韧的；能迅速恢复的

forms.note: 有弹性的；坚韧的；能迅速恢复的

coreImage: 橡皮球砸地——不碎裂不凹陷，以同样力道弹回手中，砸得越重弹得越高。玻璃硬而脆（一砸即碎），泥巴软而瘫（一砸不弹）。resilient是"韧"：受压变形，压力消失即复原，往往弹得比原来更高。

semanticRadii.label: 材料/物体
semanticRadii.example: The resilient foam retains its shape after years of use.

semanticRadii.label: 系统/经济
semanticRadii.example: The economy proved more resilient than analysts predicted.

semanticRadii.label: 生态/网络
semanticRadii.example: A resilient ecosystem absorbs shocks without collapsing.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: be resilient to + 冲击名词：resilient to stress/climate change/market volatility。emotionally/psychologically/mentally resilient（心理韧性细分）。prove/remain resilient（经考验证明有韧性）。"build resilience" 在政策/教育语境中比 "become resilient" 更常用。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She's the most resilient person I know — every setback fuels her next breakthrough.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 破折号后用"fuel"代替"recover"——resilient是把逆境转化为动力。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Coral reefs are resilient, but there's a tipping point beyond which they cannot bounce back.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: "resilient, but"让步结构——韧性有极限，科学语境平衡乐观与现实。

synonymComparisons.difference: 承受压力但不涉及"回弹"机制
synonymComparisons.example: The material is tough enough to withstand heavy impacts.

synonymComparisons.difference: 静态属性：力量大/坚固，不涉及恢复过程
synonymComparisons.example: He's strong enough to carry the load, but is he resilient enough to handle failure?

synonymComparisons.difference: 能弯曲适应，强调"可变通性"而非恢复力
synonymComparisons.example: A flexible schedule adapts; a resilient mindset bounces back.

synonymComparisons.difference: 长期耐磨，不涉及受冲击后恢复
synonymComparisons.example: The boots are durable; the insole is resilient and rebounds each step.

oneLinePenetration: resilient ≠ strong。玻璃strong（硬度高）但零resilient。橡皮不strong但highly resilient。resilient是动态恢复过程，strong是静态力量属性。

forms.note: 核心词性：决心；决议；解决；清晰度

coreImage: 元旦夜，你在日记本上写下"今年要减20斤"。这份分辨率极高的决心——resolution——闪闪发光。但同时，联合国在通过一项和平 resolution，你的电视正在播放4K resolution 的画面，而显微镜下的细胞正在以惊人的 resolution 展现生命的细节。同一个词，通向四个完全不同的世界：你的意志力、国际政治、电子屏幕和科学仪器。resolution 是个多面手。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: The UN Security Council passed a resolution condemning the invasion.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.structure: n. resolution of + 问题/冲突
semanticRadii.example: Both parties are working towards a peaceful resolution of the dispute.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: resolution 做"决心"解时常用 make a resolution，做"决议"解时用 pass/adopt a resolution，做"解决"解时用 the resolution of sth。做"清晰度"解时常见 high/low resolution 搭配（常被缩写为 hi-res 和 low-res）。动词 resolve 也可指"下定决心"（resolve to do）或"解决问题"（resolve a conflict）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: His New Year's resolutions rarely survived the first week of January.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: resolution 的可数用法和 surviving 拟人化，表明决心很脆弱。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The dispute was brought to a swift resolution through mediation.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: resolution 在此是"解决方案"而非"决心"，bring to resolution 为固定搭配。

exampleDiagnoses.example: This microscope has a resolution of 0.2 nanometers.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 科学语境下的 resolution 指"分辨能力"，与前两个义项截然不同。

synonymComparisons.difference: 正式决心或正式决定，可数名词
synonymComparisons.example: She stuck to her resolution to wake up at 6 every day.

synonymComparisons.difference: 持续的意志品质，不可数且抽象
synonymComparisons.example: It takes great determination to finish a marathon.

synonymComparisons.difference: 日常选择，轻量级，不一定有决心色彩
synonymComparisons.example: I made a quick decision to take the earlier train.

synonymComparisons.difference: 解决问题的具体办法，偏方案
synonymComparisons.example: Engineers found a solution to the overheating issue.

oneLinePenetration: resolution 是"我决定了"的正式宣言，determination 是"我一定能"的持续意志，decision 是"我选这个"的动作。

forms.note: 核心词性：共鸣，共振，回响

coreImage: 你听一首老歌，前奏响起的瞬间，十年前某个夏夜的所有细节突然涌回来——气味、光线、那个人的侧脸。你没有被电击，但你全身的细胞都"震动"了一下。这就是 resonance 的魔力：一个频率触碰到了另一个频率的固有振动点，于是它自动跟着响了起来。物理课上，它叫共振；在人心里，它叫"说到我心坎里去了"。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.meaning: 与某人或群体产生共鸣
semanticRadii.example: His message resonated with voters in rural areas.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: He spoke in a deep, resonant voice that filled the hall.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: resonate with 是核心搭配，主语是提议/作品/话语，with 后面是与之产生共鸣的人或群体。resonance 常与 deep/strong/emotional/cultural 搭配。在物理学（acoustic resonance）和艺术批评中都是高频词。形容词 resonant 可以形容声音洪亮悦耳，也可以形容某建筑空间音效好。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The idea of community ownership has strong resonance in rural areas.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 抽象概念拥有 resonance，表明它与当地人的价值观"同频"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Her words resonated with a generation that felt ignored.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: resonate with + 群体，表明话语精准击中了他们的集体情绪。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The hall's design gives it a natural acoustic resonance.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 物理意义上的"共鸣"，hall 的回响效果属于声学特性。

synonymComparisons.difference: 频率层面的契合，物理和心理均可
synonymComparisons.example: His speech had a particular resonance for immigrants.

synonymComparisons.difference: 声音的反射，或观点的重复，无主动振动
synonymComparisons.example: Her criticism echoed my own thoughts.

synonymComparisons.difference: 人与人之间的融洽关系
synonymComparisons.example: She quickly built a rapport with her students.

synonymComparisons.difference: 同情和怜悯，情感单向流动
synonymComparisons.example: I have no sympathy for people who cheat.

oneLinePenetration: resonance 是两者一起震动，echo 是声音弹回来，rapport 是两人聊得来，sympathy 是一个人同情另一个人。

forms.note: 核心词性：恢复；修复；归还

coreImage: 博物馆的地下室里，一位修复师正用小刷子一点一点清理一幅15世纪的油画。画面上堆积了几百年的灰尘和氧化的清漆，原本的色彩被掩盖了。修复师不添加任何新的东西，不做任何"改进"，她的全部工作就是抹去时间留下的痕迹，让画回到它最初的样子。这就是 restore——不是创造新东西，是恢复旧东西。从偏离状态拉回到原来的基准线，那条基准线就是事物本来的正常状态。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: Experts spent years restoring the ancient fresco.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: The stolen painting was restored to its rightful owner.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: restore sth to sb/sth 表示归还给某人或恢复到某状态，如 restore confidence to the market（恢复市场信心）。restore sth to its former glory/state 是固定搭配，表示恢复昔日辉煌。be restored to + n. 用于表示被恢复到某职位或状态，如 He was restored to power（他恢复了权力）。名词 restoration 常用于历史建筑或艺术品的修复工程。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The new manager restored order to the chaotic department.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: restore order——不是建立新秩序，是让混乱回到有序，基准线是"本该有的秩序"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Experts spent years restoring the ancient fresco.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 物理修复——从剥落到完整，修复师的工作是完全可逆的，每一笔都在接近原貌。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The stolen painting was restored to its rightful owner.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 归还义——物归原主，restore 在此是"让所有权回到本来状态"。

synonymComparisons.difference: 回到原来的状态，基准线是"原来的正常状态"
synonymComparisons.example: The team restored the vintage car to mint condition.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏自我痊愈或失而复得，不如 restore 正式和主动
synonymComparisons.example: She recovered from the illness after three months.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏机械修理故障，不涉及"复原到原有审美/历史状态"
synonymComparisons.example: He repaired the broken chair with glue.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏复活/重新活跃，不强调回到原来状态
synonymComparisons.example: The rain revived the dying plants in the garden.

oneLinePenetration: restore = re(回去) + store(存放) → 放回原位。核心永远是"回到原来的那个点上"，不是前进也不是重新开始。

forms.note: 核心词性：抑制；约束；阻止

coreImage: 一匹烈马闻到远处母马的气味，四蹄刨地，鼻翼翕张，眼看就要挣断缰绳冲出去。骑手死死拽住缰绳，手臂上的肌肉暴起，整个人后仰成45度，用全身的重量把马往回拉。马没有停止想冲的冲动，它仍然在发力，只是那股力被另一个反向的力控制住了。这就是 restrain——不是让冲动消失，是在失控边缘施加一个恰好够用的反向力。可以是自我施加的克制，也可以是外力施加的约束。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: The police had to restrain the violent protester.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: Government spending cuts are meant to restrain inflation.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: restrain sb from doing sth 是核心结构，表示阻止某人做某事，如 They restrained him from attacking。restrain oneself 表示自我克制，如 She could barely restrain herself from laughing。be restrained by 表示被某物约束，如 The dog was restrained by a leash。名词 restraint 常用于短语 show/exercise restraint（表现克制）和 without restraint（毫无节制）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He restrained his urge to shout at the unfair decision.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 自我克制——urge 是冲动正在爆发，restrain 是自我施加的反向力，忍住没说出口。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The police had to restrain the violent protester.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 外力约束——protester 已在行动，police 施加物理控制，restrain 含"制服"的力度感。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Government spending cuts are meant to restrain inflation.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 经济语境——inflation 是冲出去的烈马，spending cuts 是拉住它的缰绳，控制但不消灭。

synonymComparisons.difference: 在失控边缘施加反向力，可自我也可外力
synonymComparisons.example: I had to restrain myself from laughing during the funeral.

synonymComparisons.difference: 侧重外部限制或强迫，不如 restrain 有"拉"的动态意象
synonymComparisons.example: Our budget constrains what we can achieve this year.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调暴力压制到底、不容表达，比 restrain 更彻底
synonymComparisons.example: The regime suppressed all political dissent.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏控制增长或不良行为，常用于政策语境
synonymComparisons.example: New measures aim to curb carbon emissions by 2030.

oneLinePenetration: restrain 是"往回拉"的力，既可以是自己的刹车，也可以是别人的缰绳——关键在于动势存在但被压制住了。

forms.note: 核心词性：使复活；重新使用，复兴

coreImage: 一支90年代的乐队解散二十年后突然宣布重组巡演，社交媒体炸了。老粉丝翻出泛黄的海报，新粉丝补课老专辑。resurrect 就是这种——把已经"死掉"的东西重新带回人间。它不一定是宗教意义上的复活，也可以是一个被遗忘的传统、一个被淘汰的技术、或一段被埋葬的旧情。resurrect 的魔法在于，它让不可能变得再次可能。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.meaning: 复兴旧传统或重启旧计划
semanticRadii.example: The government is trying to resurrect a controversial highway project.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: The resurrection of vinyl records surprised the music industry.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: resurrect 是及物动词，宾语可以是具体的人或抽象的事物。当宾语是已故的人时，通常用于宗教或神话语境，日常语境中慎用（可能显得不敬）。resurrect the past 是比喻，表示重新挖出过去的往事。resurrection 前常用定冠词 the，在基督教语境中 the Resurrection 专指耶稣的复活。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The director managed to resurrect his career with one brilliant film.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: resurrect career 是高频比喻，暗示事业此前已经濒死。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Old rivalries were resurrected during the heated debate.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 被动语态 resurrect + rivalry，揭示了"复活"也可以是不好的东西。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The resurrection of the downtown area has attracted new businesses.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: resurrection 用作名词表达城市街区的复兴，商业报道常见。

synonymComparisons.difference: 使已死亡/消亡的事物重新恢复
synonymComparisons.example: She resurrected an old family recipe for the cookbook.

synonymComparisons.difference: 使暂时失去活力的事物重新振作，强度较弱
synonymComparisons.example: Cold water revived the unconscious swimmer.

synonymComparisons.difference: 将某物修复到原来的状态
synonymComparisons.example: They restored the old painting to its original glory.

synonymComparisons.difference: 使契约、行动、精力重新开始或继续
synonymComparisons.example: We decided not to renew the lease.

oneLinePenetration: resurrect 是起死回生的奇迹，revive 是救回晕过去的人，restore 是把破的修成新的，renew 是"续一下"。

forms.note: 核心词性：保留；保持；记住；聘请

coreImage: 你手里攥着一把沙子，手指稍微松一松，沙子就从指缝间漏出去了。你想留住它，就必须持续用力握紧。retain 就是这只攥紧的手——你已经有这个东西，关键不是去获得它，而是不让它跑掉。水分从皮肤里蒸发，公司的人才被对手挖走，学过的单词从记忆中褪色——这些都在流失，而 retain 就是对抗这种自然流失趋势的那股维持力。它不是创造，不是获取，是牢牢攥住已有之物。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: The company struggles to retain talented engineers.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: Despite her age, she retains a sharp memory.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: retain + n. 是最常用的结构，直接跟保留的对象。retain the right to do sth 表示保留做某事的权利。retain sb as + 职位表示留任某人，如 She was retained as a consultant。retain a lawyer/attorney 特指预付费用聘请律师。名词 retention 常用于 customer retention（客户留存）、employee retention（员工留任）等商业语境。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The company struggles to retain talented engineers.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 人才留任——engineers 在流失，struggles 说明 retain 需要持续努力对抗外部吸引力。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Despite her age, she retains a sharp memory.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 能力维持——age 是流失的原因（自然衰老），retains 强调记忆力的顽强存在。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The landlord retains the right to inspect the property.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 权利保留——right 不是刚获得的，是一直持有的，只是强调"不放弃"的状态。

synonymComparisons.difference: 牢牢攥住已有之物，对抗自然流失趋势
synonymComparisons.example: The sponge retains moisture even in dry conditions.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏"维护使其延续"，需要付出持续努力来保持状态
synonymComparisons.example: She maintains her fitness by running daily.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏"保护免于损坏"，侧重防护和保存原有状态
synonymComparisons.example: The museum preserves ancient artifacts in controlled conditions.

synonymComparisons.difference: 最通用"保持/保留"，口语化，缺乏 retain 的正式感和持续性
synonymComparisons.example: You can keep the book, I've already read it.

oneLinePenetration: retain 是"牢牢攥住已有之物"——无论是信息、员工、权利还是水分，对抗的都是自然流失的趋势。

coreImage: 敌国向你的边境发射了一枚导弹，你的国防部决定在对方发射架还没冷却之前，就把两倍的火力送回去。retaliate 的逻辑是"以牙还牙"的升级版——你要为受到的伤害讨回一个更响亮的公道。它不是街头斗殴的即时还手，而是经过权衡后的对等反击。retaliate 的冷酷在于，它不是出于愤怒，而是出于"必须如此"的战略清醒。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: She retaliated by spreading rumors about him.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: The tariffs were raised in retaliation for unfair trade practices.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: retaliate 是不及物动词，需要借助 against（报复对象）或 with/by（报复方式）来完整表达。retaliation 是不可数名词，常用 in retaliation for 表示"为了报复…"。retaliatory 修饰名词时多用于正式或军事语境，如 retaliatory strike、retaliatory measures。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The company fired him, and he retaliated by leaking sensitive documents to the press.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: retaliate by 说明报复的方式，暗示被解雇在前，泄密是回应。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Military officials warned that any attack would be met with swift retaliation.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: met with retaliation 是被动，swift 强调报复的及时性，军事外交高频表达。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She refused to retaliate, choosing instead to take the high road.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: refuse to retaliate 暗示报复是本能冲动，克制是需要意志的选择。

synonymComparisons.difference: 对等但经过权衡的报复，冷静克制
synonymComparisons.example: She retaliated against the bully by reporting him.

synonymComparisons.difference: 充满情感的个人复仇，不考虑后果
synonymComparisons.example: He spent years plotting his revenge.

synonymComparisons.difference: 为他人讨回公道，带有正义感
synonymComparisons.example: He swore to avenge his father's murder.

synonymComparisons.difference: 以同样的善意或恶意回应，非纯负面
synonymComparisons.example: She smiled at me, and I reciprocated.

oneLinePenetration: retaliate 是算账式的回敬，revenge 是热血上头的复仇，avenge 是替天行道的复仇，reciprocate 是礼尚往来。

forms.note: 核心词性：撤退，退却；静修处

coreImage: 前方的部队伤亡太大，指挥官下令后撤到第二道防线。这不是逃跑，而是战略收缩——把拳头收回来，是为了下一次更有力地打出去。同时，resort 广告里那个面朝雪山、没有手机信号的湖边木屋，也叫 retreat——不是败退，而是主动从喧嚣中撤出。同一个词承载了战场上的狼狈转折和生活中最奢侈的自我修复。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: When the rain started, we beat a hasty retreat to the car.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.structure: n. a retreat from + 立场
semanticRadii.example: The announcement marks a retreat from earlier promises.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: retreat 做动词是不及物的，需要 from/to 指明撤退的方向。beat a retreat 是成语，画面感来自军队击鼓收兵，现在多用于幽默语境。当 retreat 指"静修处"时是可数名词，如 a yoga retreat。retreat into oneself 是比喻，表示退缩到自己的内心世界。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The army was in full retreat after days of intense fighting.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: in full retreat 意味着全面溃退，不是有序撤离，画面极端。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She went on a silent retreat to decompress from the corporate world.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: retreat 作为"静修"的用法，silent 强化了隔绝和自省的意图。

exampleDiagnoses.example: His comments were seen as a retreat from earlier commitments on climate policy.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: retreat from 加抽象名词的比喻用法，表示政治立场的后退。

synonymComparisons.difference: 有序或被迫的后退，军事或个人均可
synonymComparisons.example: The enemy retreated under cover of darkness.

synonymComparisons.difference: 主动撤离，强调从参与中抽出
synonymComparisons.example: The company decided to withdraw from the market.

synonymComparisons.difference: 因极度恐惧仓皇逃跑，毫无秩序
synonymComparisons.example: Civilians fled the city as the bombs fell.

synonymComparisons.difference: 从参照点向远退去，常指洪水或发际线
synonymComparisons.example: His hairline is starting to recede.

oneLinePenetration: retreat 是撤退（有序）或静修（自愿），withdraw 是自己选择退出，flee 是撒腿就跑，recede 是慢慢退远。

forms.note: 核心词性：取回；检索；挽回

coreImage: 你把钥匙掉进了下水道口，用铁丝弯了一个钩子，趴在地上往里探，晃了半天终于感觉钩子挂住了什么，小心翼翼地提上来——钥匙回来了。retrieve 就是这三个动作连在一起：搜寻、找到、拿回。金毛寻回犬跳进湖里把主人丢出去的球叼回来，数据库引擎在亿条记录里定位你要的那一条，外交官在谈判破裂的最后一刻挽回局面——看似风马牛不相及，共享的是同一个底层逻辑：主动去找到并带回来。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: He dove into the river to retrieve the dropped ring.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.meaning: 挽回糟糕的局面或名誉
semanticRadii.example: She tried to retrieve the situation with a joke, but it fell flat.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: retrieve sth from + place 表示从某处取回某物，如 retrieve files from the database。manage to retrieve 强调经过努力终于取回，暗示有难度。retrieve + n. + for sb 表示帮某人取回某物。名词 retrieval 用作 data retrieval（数据检索）、information retrieval（信息检索）等技术语境。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The system can retrieve customer records within seconds.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 数据检索——system 主动在数据库中搜寻并定位，within seconds 强调效率，三步走被压缩到一秒内。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He dove into the river to retrieve the dropped ring.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 物理取回——dove 是搜寻动作的开始，river 是需要进入的环境，ring 是目标，整个句子本身就是 retrieve 的三步走叙事。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She tried to retrieve the situation with a joke, but it fell flat.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 挽回局面——situation 是掉进"下水道"的东西（搞砸的场合），joke 是弯成钩子的铁丝，fell flat 说明"没勾上来"。

synonymComparisons.difference: 主动去搜寻并拿回，隐含三步过程：搜寻、找到、拿回
synonymComparisons.example: He managed to retrieve the files from the crashed hard drive.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏"重新获得"，可以是被动等待归还，不一定自己去取
synonymComparisons.example: She recovered from the illness after a month of treatment.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏"去取来"，口语化，不用于数据或抽象事物
synonymComparisons.example: Could you fetch me a glass of water?

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏重新获得抽象事物如信心/控制/意识，不涉及物理搜寻
synonymComparisons.example: He gradually regained consciousness in the hospital.

oneLinePenetration: retrieve = re(回来) + trieve(trouver=找到) → 去找到并带回来。核心是"搜寻→找到→拿回"三步走，对比 recover 是被归还，retrieve 是自己去捞。

forms.note: 核心词性：揭露，揭示；惊人的发现

coreImage: 你整理去世父亲的遗物，在一本旧书里发现了一封信。父亲年轻时曾在另一个城市有过一个家庭，而你对此一无所知。revelation 就是这种"一瞬间世界被重新编码"的体验——一个被埋藏的真相突然照亮了一切，让过去所有说不通的细节都有了新的解释。它可以令人振奋（科学发现），也可以令人崩溃（隐瞒的背叛）。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: The investigation revealed widespread corruption.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: He let slip a revealing remark about his true intentions.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: revelation 是可数名词，常用结构有 come as a revelation（出乎意料地令人恍然大悟的发现）和 the revelation that…（…这一事实的披露）。reveal 是及物动词，后面接被揭示的东西，也可用 reveal that 从句。revealing 做形容词常用于指暴露身材的衣服或暴露内心的话。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The revelation that the CEO had been embezzling funds sent shockwaves through the industry.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: revelation that 引出具体揭露的内容，后面跟的是被隐藏的事实。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Reading her diary was a revelation — I had no idea she was so unhappy.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: a revelation 用于表示某种颠覆认知的发现，完全改变你对一个人的看法。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The documentary contains shocking revelations about the government's role in the disaster.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: revelations 复数表示一连串被披露的内幕，强化了爆料的层次感。

synonymComparisons.difference: 突然揭示的惊人事实，强调的是被揭示的内容本身
synonymComparisons.example: The leaked documents were a revelation.

synonymComparisons.difference: 正式或有义务的信息公开，偏程序性
synonymComparisons.example: Full disclosure of conflicts of interest is required.

synonymComparisons.difference: 通过探索或研究首次发现，不一定含秘密成分
synonymComparisons.example: The discovery of penicillin changed medicine forever.

synonymComparisons.difference: 将阴暗面公之于众，含有揭发和保护公众意味
synonymComparisons.example: The exposure of the scandal led to his resignation.

oneLinePenetration: revelation 是惊天秘密被揭开，disclosure 是按规矩公开信息，discovery 是科学家的新发现，exposure 是记者把黑幕拿到阳光下。

forms.note: 核心词性：逆转；倒车；推翻

coreImage: 想象你在一条单行道上开车，突然发现前面路断了，你挂上倒挡，车开始往后走。倒车这个动作的精髓不是"停下来"，而是"朝完全相反的方向重新出发"。reverse 就是这辆挂倒挡的车——它不是微调方向盘，而是把整个方向、顺序、结果彻底倒过来。法院 reverse 下级判决，不是修改判决措辞，而是无罪变有罪；公司 reverse 下滑趋势，不是稳住不跌，而是从亏变盈；你把名单 reverse，不是调整几个人名，而是第一个人变成最后一个。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: The new policy failed to reverse the economic downturn.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: She reversed the car into a tight parking spot.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: reverse + n. 直接跟需要逆转的对象，如 reverse the damage/effects of sth。put the car in reverse 是倒车的固定说法。the reverse is also true 表示反之亦然，用于逻辑论证。in reverse order 按相反顺序。形容词 irreversible 常用于 irreversible damage/change（不可逆的伤害/变化），语气强烈。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The court reversed the lower court's ruling.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 法律语境——不是修改而是彻底推翻，ruling 从 A 变成非 A，整个结论被反转。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The new policy failed to reverse the economic downturn.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: failed to reverse ——政策没能把 downtrend 变成 upturn，说明 reverse 的要求很高：不是稳住就是反转。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She reversed the car into a tight parking spot.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 物理动作——车头朝外的逻辑被"反过来"，倒着进入，tight 暗示难度，reverse 在此是精确的操控。

synonymComparisons.difference: 180度方向性反转，从 A→B 变成 B→A
synonymComparisons.example: Scientists are working to reverse the effects of climate change.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏彻底推翻，常用于法律/制度，比 reverse 更彻底更具破坏感
synonymComparisons.example: The Supreme Court overturned the decades-old precedent.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏取消/撤销操作，口语化，如电脑中的 undo
synonymComparisons.example: You can't undo what you said — the damage is already done.

synonymComparisons.difference: 不及物，回到之前状态，不如 reverse 主动和有力
synonymComparisons.example: After the upgrade failed, the system reverted to the previous version.

oneLinePenetration: reverse 是"从 A→B 变成 B→A"，强调方向性反转——是逆转而非暂停。

posNote: 恢复，回到（之前的状态/话题）

forms.note: 核心词性：恢复，回到（之前的状态/话题）

coreImage: 你试了三个月的素食，体检报告出来铁元素偏低，于是你又开始在餐盘里放回牛肉。公司上线了新系统，结果比旧版还糟糕，所有人都在大喊"换回去"。revert 就是这种"回到原点"的动作——不管你绕了多远的路，花哨地尝试了多少新花样，最后一键 reset，回到你出发的地方。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: Let me revert to the point I made earlier.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: The land will undergo reversion to the original owner.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: revert 是不及物动词，必须搭配 to：revert to sth。注意 revert back 是冗余表达，应避免。revert to type 是固定搭配，意为"恢复本性，老毛病又犯了"。在英式商务英语中，revert to someone 有时表示"再联系某人回复"（I'll revert to you next week），但美式英语中不常用。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Without regular maintenance, the garden quickly reverted to a wild state.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: revert to + 状态，暗示如果没有维护，事物会自然地退化回原始状态。

exampleDiagnoses.example: In times of stress, he reverted to his childhood habit of biting his nails.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 压力触发了回归旧习惯，revert 体现了负面行为的顽固性。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The conversation kept reverting to the topic of money.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: revert to 话题表示讨论不断被拉回到某个焦点，非计划中的偏离。

synonymComparisons.difference: 被动地回到之前的自然状态或原主手中
synonymComparisons.example: The property reverts to the state if no heir is found.

synonymComparisons.difference: 主动选择回来或归还，最通用的"回"
synonymComparisons.example: She returned to her hometown after college.

synonymComparisons.difference: 退步到更差的阶段，带贬义
synonymComparisons.example: Without practice, his language skills regressed.

synonymComparisons.difference: 主动将某物修复到原来的样子
synonymComparisons.example: The museum restored the painting to its original condition.

oneLinePenetration: revert 是"弹回去"的自然回归，return 是"走回去"的主动选择，regress 是"退回去"的变差，restore 是"修回去"的修复。

forms.note: 核心词性：修订；修改；复习（英）

coreImage: 你把写好的论文放在桌上，去泡了杯咖啡，回来重新坐下来，用一双陌生的眼睛审视自己刚才写的东西——第二段论证有漏洞，第三章的例子不合适，标题太啰嗦。你拿起笔开始修改。revise 的本质就是这个"再看一次"的瞬间。它来自拉丁语 re（再次）+ vis（看），revise 就是再看一遍并改进。不是凭空重写，不是从零开始，而是在已有基础上，基于重新审视的修正。就像一个雕塑家退后三步，眯着眼看自己的作品，然后走近把它修得更接近理想。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: The company revised its earnings forecast downward.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: He spent the weekend revising for his history exam.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: revise sth upward/downward 表示向上或向下修订数据，如 revise the forecast upward。revise sth for + purpose 表示为某目的修改，如 revise the contract for clarity。be revised to + 数字表示修订后的结果。英式英语中 revise for an exam 等于美式英语的 study for an exam。名词 revision 常用于 make revisions（做修改）和 undergo revision（正在修订中）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She revised the essay three times before submitting it.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: three times——说明 revise 是迭代过程，每次"再看一眼"都能发现新问题，不是一次性修改。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The company revised its earnings forecast downward.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: forecast downward——数据不是算错了，是重新审视后调整预期，"再看一眼"发现之前太乐观了。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He spent the weekend revising for his history exam.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 英式用法——"复习"的本质也是"再看一遍"，把学过的东西重新审视并巩固。

synonymComparisons.difference: 基于重新审视的修正，保留整体框架进行优化
synonymComparisons.example: The author revised the novel based on feedback from early readers.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏小改或调整，不强调"重新审视"的过程
synonymComparisons.example: They modified the design slightly to reduce costs.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏正式修改法律/条款，比 revise 更严肃更正式
synonymComparisons.example: The constitution was amended to include new civil rights.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏编辑加工，可能在别人作品上改，revise 多是改自己的东西
synonymComparisons.example: The editor reviewed and edited the manuscript for publication.

oneLinePenetration: revise 不是推倒重来，而是"再看一眼，把不好的地方修掉"——大脑里有一个"对照标准→发现偏差→修正"的迭代过程。

posNote: 使复苏，使复兴，重新上演

forms.note: 核心词性：使复苏，使复兴，重新上演

coreImage: 一个溺水的人被拖上岸，脸已经发紫。急救员做了两分钟心肺复苏后，他突然咳出一口水，睁开了眼睛。revive 的第一个画面就是"把快死的人救回来"。但它更常用的场景是：一条荒废的商业街因为一家网红咖啡馆重新活了，一部五十年前的冷门话剧又被搬上舞台。revive 不像 resurrect 那样从死亡中召回，而是把奄奄一息的火苗重新吹旺。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.meaning: 重新点燃兴趣或复兴传统
semanticRadii.example: The festival aims to revive traditional crafts.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.structure: n. revival + of + 产业/兴趣
semanticRadii.example: There has been a revival of interest in vinyl records.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: revive 是及物和不及物均可的动词。可以直接跟宾语（revive the economy），也可以不加宾语（the economy is starting to revive）。revive memories 指"唤起记忆"，revive someone with cold water 指"用冷水把人弄醒"。revival 做名词时常用 there has been a revival of interest in... 表示某事物重新流行。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The rain revived the wilting flowers within an hour.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 物理层面的 revival——水让干枯的生命重新挺起来，画面感极强。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Efforts to revive the dying language have gained momentum.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: revive a language 是比喻，将濒危语言拟人化为需要抢救的生命体。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She fainted from the heat, but a splash of cold water quickly revived her.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: revive sb 最字面的用法，从昏迷中苏醒过来。

synonymComparisons.difference: 使失去活力的事物重新振作，半死不活的抢救
synonymComparisons.example: The cold weather revived her spirits after the long summer.

synonymComparisons.difference: 使完全消亡的事物重新出现，从零复活
synonymComparisons.example: The director wants to resurrect a film project abandoned in 1995.

synonymComparisons.difference: 修复到原来的状态，偏物理或秩序恢复
synonymComparisons.example: They restored power to the neighborhood within hours.

synonymComparisons.difference: 使人或组织恢复青春活力，带焕然一新的美感
synonymComparisons.example: A week at the spa completely rejuvenated her.

oneLinePenetration: revive 是"快醒醒"的人工呼吸，resurrect 是"回来吧"的招魂术，restore 是"修好它"的工匠活，rejuvenate 是"变年轻"的美容觉。

forms.note: 核心词性：反抗，叛乱；使厌恶
令人恶心的，令人作呕的

coreImage: 一群人扛着自制武器冲向总督府的大门，侍卫在慌乱中开枪，但人潮根本不退。revolt 的第一层是"官逼民反"——当压迫超过了忍受的极限，最驯服的绵羊也会变成最疯狂的公牛。但 revolt 还有一个更日常的用法：你咬了一口坏掉的鸡蛋，整个胃都在翻江倒海地 revolt——不是政治上的叛乱，而是身体在说"这种东西我不接受"。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.example: The students revolted against the new dress code.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.example: The sight of blood makes me revolt.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: revolt 做"起义"解时是不及物动词，用 revolt against。做"使恶心"解时是及物动词，主语是令人不悦的事物，宾语是受影响的人，也可用于被动 be revolted by。revolting 是形容词，表示"令人极度恶心的"，语气比 disgusting 更强烈。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The peasants rose in revolt after another tax increase.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: rise in revolt 是固定搭配，表示从被动忍受到主动反抗的临界点被突破。

exampleDiagnoses.example: I was revolted by his casual cruelty towards animals.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: was revolted by 表示心理层面的强烈反感，近乎生理性的厌恶。

exampleDiagnoses.example: What began as a small protest quickly escalated into a full-scale revolt.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 从 protest 到 revolt 的升级路径，revolt 是暴力的，protest 是和平的。

synonymComparisons.difference: 集体暴力反抗，或生理/心理的抗拒
synonymComparisons.example: The revolt spread from village to village.

synonymComparisons.difference: 对权威的持续对抗，不一定暴力
synonymComparisons.example: Teenage rebellion is a normal phase of development.

synonymComparisons.difference: 突然爆发的短暂群众起义
synonymComparisons.example: The uprising was put down within 48 hours.

synonymComparisons.difference: 有组织有政治目标的武装暴动
synonymComparisons.example: The insurrection aimed to overthrow the government.

oneLinePenetration: revolt 是"不干了"的起义，rebellion 是"我不听你的"的对抗，uprising 是"忍无可忍、突然爆发"的群众运动，insurrection 是"要换老板"的武装政变。

posNote: 正义的，公正的；（贬义）自以为是的

forms.note: 核心词性：正义的，公正的；（贬义）自以为是的
自以为是的，自命清高的

coreImage: 你看到一个壮汉在地铁上辱骂一个瘦弱的老人，整个车厢的人都在低头玩手机。你站了起来，声音在发抖，但你说出了那句"够了"。righteous 的正面面孔是这样的：你做的事是正义的，在那一刻你是正确方的化身。但它也有阴暗面——那个在网络上用道德大棒砸每一个"堕落者"的键盘侠，他也觉得自己很 righteous。righteous 的危险在于，它可以让正义感滑向自以为是。

semanticRadii.label: 半径1
semanticRadii.meaning: 正直的好人（常带宗教色彩）
semanticRadii.example: The righteous shall inherit the earth.

semanticRadii.label: 半径2
semanticRadii.meaning: 自以为是的，自命不凡的
semanticRadii.example: His self-righteous lectures annoyed everyone.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: righteous 可以修饰抽象的情绪名词（righteous anger, righteous indignation），此时是褒义。单独用来形容人（a righteous man）通常带宗教或严肃道德色彩。self-righteous 已经完全异化为贬义词，专指那些站在道德高地上评判他人的人。注意与 right（正确的）、self-right（权利的）区分。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She spoke with righteous indignation about the company's exploitation of workers.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: righteous indignation 是褒义的"义愤填膺"，indignation 自带正义光环。

exampleDiagnoses.example: I'm tired of his self-righteous preaching about healthy eating.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: self-righteous 是贬义——不吃这些不证明你在道德上更高尚。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The cause was righteous, but their methods were deeply flawed.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: righteous cause 肯定目的的正义性，同时批评手段的正当性独立于目的。

synonymComparisons.difference: 道德上的正义感，容易滑向自以为是
synonymComparisons.example: Her righteous fury made everyone fall silent.

synonymComparisons.difference: 符合普遍的道德准则，较中性和客观
synonymComparisons.example: It's our moral duty to help those in need.

synonymComparisons.difference: 符合职业道德或专业伦理规范
synonymComparisons.example: The lawyer's behavior was not ethical.

synonymComparisons.difference: 品德高尚，偏重个人德行而非对外评判
synonymComparisons.example: She led a virtuous life devoted to charity.

oneLinePenetration: righteous 是"我就是对的"的正义感（可好可坏），moral 是"对与错"的客观标尺，ethical 是"行规上过得去"，virtuous 是"人品好"的内在修为。

posNote: 严格的；缜密的——极为细致、不放过任何细节

forms.note: 严格的；缜密的——极为细致、不放过任何细节

coreImage: 教授翻完你的论文，红笔划了17处——不是针对你，是每个跳过的论证他都追到了尽头。像登山者一粒一粒检查绳索：不是不信任，是山在那里、命在手里。rigor如同匠人打磨镜片：一遍遍抛光，只为让真相更清晰一分。

semanticRadii.label: 训练描写
semanticRadii.example: Navy SEALs undergo rigorous physical and mental training.

semanticRadii.label: 标准描写
semanticRadii.example: Only products meeting rigorous safety standards are approved.

semanticRadii.label: 审视/调查
semanticRadii.example: The committee conducted a rigorous review of the budget.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 标准搭配：rigorous + methodology/standards/training/examination/tests。程度修饰：academically/intellectually/scientifically rigorous。常见主语：process, approach, curriculum, regime。不用于形容日常琐事的严格（用strict更自然：strict curfew, NOT rigorous curfew）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The program is academically rigorous but emotionally supportive.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 对比张力——严格与支持并不矛盾。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He approached the puzzle with rigorous logic, leaving no assumption unchallenged.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 思维品质——自反式的缜密。

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调服从规则，常用于纪律
synonymComparisons.example: My parents were strict about bedtime.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调全面、不遗漏
synonymComparisons.example: She did a thorough cleaning of every drawer.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调极其注意细节，可偏个人习惯
synonymComparisons.example: He's meticulous about filing receipts by date.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调按系统步骤推进
synonymComparisons.example: We need a systematic approach to fix this bug.

oneLinePenetration: rigorous = system（有序）+ thorough（全面）+ strict（高标准）的三位一体。它不是苛刻——苛刻是态度，rigorous是方法论。一个rigorous的人不是让你难受，是让错误无处可藏。

posNote: 仪式；惯例——固定的程序化行为序列

forms.note: 仪式；惯例——固定的程序化行为序列

coreImage: 每天早晨第一件事不是看手机而是磨豆、闻香、手冲——这套动作本身比咖啡更重要。原始人在山洞里围火击鼓，现代人在格子间端杯碰杯：不管信什么，人都需要重复来确认秩序。ritual是一种把日常钉在意义锚点上的重复，把时光从流沙变成石碑。

semanticRadii.label: 日常习惯
semanticRadii.example: Her morning ritual of yoga and tea sets the day's tone.

semanticRadii.label: 社会活动
semanticRadii.example: The company's holiday party has become an annual ritual.

semanticRadii.label: 心理作用
semanticRadii.example: Bedtime stories are a comforting ritual for young children.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 标准搭配：perform/observe/practice a ritual；ritual + of doing sth。常用形容词：daily, annual, ancient, sacred, elaborate。日常含义偏轻松，不是一定是宗教的。作形容词用时（ritual killing/ritual humiliation）表示"仪式性的"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The graduation ceremony, though tedious, serves an important ritual function in marking life transitions.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 仪式感的社会功能——标记过渡。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Breaking bread together is one of the oldest rituals of trust.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 文化深度——分享食物作为信任契约。

synonymComparisons.difference: 更正式、公共、一次性
synonymComparisons.example: The wedding ceremony was beautiful.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调日常重复，无仪式感
synonymComparisons.example: Brushing teeth is part of his routine.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调传统/文化传承
synonymComparisons.example: It's a local custom to give red envelopes.

synonymComparisons.difference: 个人惯性，无社会意义
synonymComparisons.example: Biting nails is a bad habit.

oneLinePenetration: ritual = routine + meaning。routine是"我每天做"，ritual是"我借这个做来告诉自己我在意什么"。ritual的核心不是动作，是动作的象征性。

posNote: 强劲的；结实的；健壮的——不易被破坏或推倒

forms.note: 强劲的；结实的；健壮的——不易被破坏或推倒

coreImage: 台风过境，路边广告牌倒了一片，只有那棵老榕树纹丝不动——根扎得深、干够粗、枝够韧。robust不是硬碰硬的刚，是"你有多大劲，我比你还多撑一秒"的余裕。一份robust的论证不是嗓门大，而是每个环节都能扛住反例的冲击。

semanticRadii.label: 论证/数据
semanticRadii.example: The study provides robust evidence for the theory.

semanticRadii.label: 身体/健康
semanticRadii.example: Despite his age, he remains in robust health.

semanticRadii.label: 产品/材料
semanticRadii.example: The laptop has a robust aluminum body.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: 标准搭配：robust + growth/economy/system/framework/evidence/defense。程度修饰：remarkably, sufficiently, surprisingly robust。可做表语也可做定语：a robust debate / the debate was robust。不用于形容纤细/易碎事物（不能用robust来形容玻璃杯）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: A robust democracy doesn't just protect majority rule; it safeguards dissent.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 政治哲学——制度韧性在容纳异见。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She gave a robust defense of her position, citing decades of research.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 辩论场景——有底气的坚持。

synonymComparisons.difference: 侧重物理结实/耐磨损
synonymComparisons.example: This sturdy backpack survived five years of daily use.

synonymComparisons.difference: 最通用，可形容力、意志、味道
synonymComparisons.example: He has a strong will.

synonymComparisons.difference: 侧重"被打击后恢复"
synonymComparisons.example: Children are remarkably resilient after trauma.

synonymComparisons.difference: 侧重精力充沛/活跃
synonymComparisons.example: She leads a vigorous exercise routine.

oneLinePenetration: robust = strong + durable + well-designed。它不是蛮力——是即使一部分坏了、另一部分还能撑住的冗余设计。robust的东西不是不会坏，是坏了也不倒。

posNote: 破裂；断裂；决裂——关系或结构上的突然断裂

forms.note: 破裂；断裂；决裂——关系或结构上的突然断裂

coreImage: 两条平行的生命线——同事、合伙人、密友——突然绷断，不是慢慢疏远，是一句话、一件事，就"砰"地一声。像橡皮筋拉到极限的瞬间，之前的张力都成了伏笔。水管里的裂缝看不见，压力到了、就爆了。rupture是断裂的那一声响，也是之前所有沉默的账。

semanticRadii.label: 人际关系
semanticRadii.example: The scandal ruptured diplomatic relations between the two countries.

semanticRadii.label: 工程地质
semanticRadii.meaning: v. 管道破裂 / n. 破裂点
semanticRadii.example: The gas explosion was caused by a pipeline rupture.

semanticRadii.label: 抽象结构
semanticRadii.example: The crisis ruptured the political consensus.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 作动词可直接及物：rupture relations/a treaty/an alliance。可不及物：The vessel ruptured under pressure.。常用被动：Relations between the two countries have been ruptured.。名词用法：a rupture in relations / a rupture between A and B。

exampleDiagnoses.example: A single leaked email ruptured a decade-long friendship.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 人际关系——信任瞬间崩塌。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The treaty's collapse didn't just rupture an alliance; it shattered a regional order.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 层层升级——破裂→碎裂→秩序崩塌。

synonymComparisons.difference: 轻微裂缝，不一定断裂
synonymComparisons.example: There's a crack in the windshield but it's still intact.

synonymComparisons.difference: 侧重物理/骨骼断裂
synonymComparisons.example: She fractured her wrist in three places.

synonymComparisons.difference: 压力下爆裂，内部→外部
synonymComparisons.example: The water pipe burst during the freeze.

synonymComparisons.difference: 主动切断，有意图
synonymComparisons.example: They severed all ties with the organization.

oneLinePenetration: rupture = 压力累积 + 突然断裂 + 不可逆。crack可以补，fracture可以接，但rupture一旦发生，回到从前就没有了。它把"突然"和"永久"同时裹在一个词里。

posNote: 抢救；打捞；挽回——从废墟或失败中救出还能用的部分

forms.note: 抢救；打捞；挽回——从废墟或失败中救出还能用的部分

coreImage: 船沉了，集装箱漂在海上——水手跳下去捞的不是黄金，是还能吃的罐头。火灾过后，消防员从灰烬里捡出一本烧焦了边角的相册。salvage不是"没出事"，而是"出事了，能抓多少抓多少"。像谈判崩了以后，双方还能握个手留条后路——不体面，但比什么都没有强。

semanticRadii.label: 挽回局面
semanticRadii.example: Couple's therapy helped them salvage their marriage.

semanticRadii.label: 抢救数据/信息
semanticRadii.example: IT managed to salvage most of the files from the corrupted drive.

semanticRadii.label: 体育/比赛
semanticRadii.example: They scored late to salvage a 2-2 draw.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 标准搭配：salvage sth from sth（从…中挽救…）。salvage + what remains / what you can / what's left。与pride/dignity/reputation连用：salvage what's left of his reputation。名词用法：beyond salvage（无法挽救）；the salvage operation。

exampleDiagnoses.example: They salvaged enough timber from the burned barn to rebuild a smaller shed.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 实物抢救——废墟中捡能用之物。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The night was a disaster, but we managed to salvage it with an impromptu bonfire on the beach.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 生活场景——靠灵活和乐观把烂摊子变成记忆。

synonymComparisons.difference: 救出整体（人或物），危险仍在
synonymComparisons.example: The firefighters rescued three people from the burning building.

synonymComparisons.difference: 找回/恢复，更广泛
synonymComparisons.example: She recovered the deleted files from the trash bin.

synonymComparisons.difference: 取回，刻意去拿
synonymComparisons.example: He retrieved his umbrella from the lost-and-found.

synonymComparisons.difference: 用后续行动挽救或弥补（偏抽象/道德）
synonymComparisons.example: He tried to redeem himself by volunteering.

oneLinePenetration: salvage = 接受已发生的损失 + 最大化剩余价值。它不是救回全部——是救回还能用的那一部分。salvage的精神是"认赔出局，但不空手而归"。

posNote: 制裁（负面）；批准/许可（正面）——罕见的双向反义词

forms.note: 制裁（负面）；批准/许可（正面）——罕见的双向反义词

coreImage: 这个词有个奇怪的灵魂：同一张脸，朝左是"批准"，朝右是"制裁"。像裁判的哨子——吹一下可以是开球（许可），也可以是叫停（惩罚）。它是权力手中的硬币：正面说"可以"，反面说"不行"，而底面是同一只手在掌控规则。

semanticRadii.label: 官方批准
semanticRadii.example: The project cannot proceed without the ministry's official sanction.

semanticRadii.label: 处罚机制
semanticRadii.example: The regulatory body imposed heavy sanctions on the bank.

semanticRadii.label: 法律层面
semanticRadii.example: The court may issue sanctions against attorneys who violate rules.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: 制裁义：impose/levy sanctions against/on sb；lift/ease sanctions。批准义：give/grant sanction to sth；with/without official sanction。常用复数形式：sanctions（制裁措施）；单数：sanction（批准/许可）。不要混淆方向：上下文决定是许可还是惩罚。

exampleDiagnoses.example: No religious ceremony was performed without the council's express sanction.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 历史语境——sanction作为正式批准。

exampleDiagnoses.example: This was a covert operation, carried out without any official sanction.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 负向许可——"未授权"的严重后果。

synonymComparisons.difference: 特指贸易禁令，禁止进出口
synonymComparisons.example: The U.S. embargo on Cuba lasted over 60 years.

synonymComparisons.difference: 自发抵制，非官方行为
synonymComparisons.example: Consumers organized a boycott of the brand.

synonymComparisons.difference: 纯正面"批准"义
synonymComparisons.example: We need board approval before hiring.

synonymComparisons.difference: 纯负面"处罚"义，通用
synonymComparisons.example: The penalty for late payment is a 10% fee.

oneLinePenetration: sanction是英语中最有趣的斯芬克斯词——同一拼写、同一发音，却有完全相反的义项。想记住它？想象国王手中的权杖：朝下一点"批准"，朝上一举"制裁"。权力既可以点燃绿灯，也可以砸下铁幕。

posNote: 使饱和；浸透——让某物完全充满另一种物质，直到不能再吸收

forms.note: 使饱和；浸透——让某物完全充满另一种物质，直到不能再吸收

coreImage: 海绵按进水里，气泡汩汩冒完后就再吸不进一滴——那就是饱和点。油锅里下了三筐薯条，油还是油，但开到最大火烟起来了——媒介已经到了极限。信息时代的我们不是渴，是被saturate：朋友圈、推送、热搜灌到满，多一滴都溢不出去。

semanticRadii.label: 市场/行业
semanticRadii.example: Cheap imports have saturated the domestic electronics market.

semanticRadii.label: 信息/媒体
semanticRadii.example: The candidate's ads saturated social media in the final week.

semanticRadii.label: 色彩/摄影
semanticRadii.example: The photographer prefers deeply saturated sunset tones.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 标准搭配：saturate sth with/in sth。被动用法：be saturated with（被…浸透/充满）。常见主语：市场被某种产品saturate；媒体被某新闻saturate。化学/摄影领域大量使用：saturated fat, saturated solution, saturated color。

exampleDiagnoses.example: By December, holiday ads had so saturated every platform that consumers stopped noticing them altogether.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 市场/广告——饱和导致麻木。

exampleDiagnoses.example: His writing is saturated with references to classical mythology, sometimes to the point of obscurity.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 文学用法——"充斥"的褒贬取决于语境。

synonymComparisons.difference: 浸泡/湿透，有过程感
synonymComparisons.example: Soak the beans overnight before cooking.

synonymComparisons.difference: 大量液体浇/淋，突然性
synonymComparisons.example: We got drenched by a sudden downpour.

synonymComparisons.difference: 渗透/弥漫，偏向无形事物穿透
synonymComparisons.example: The smell of coffee permeated the entire office.

synonymComparisons.difference: 大量涌入/淹没（量大，可淹没后褪去）
synonymComparisons.example: The market was flooded with counterfeit goods.

oneLinePenetration: saturate的关键在于"极限容量"——不是"放了多少进去"，而是"多到再也吃不下了"。像手机内存：满了就是满了。soak是过程，saturate是到达终点。

posNote: 丑闻；丑行——引发公众愤慨或道德谴责的事件

forms.note: 丑闻；丑行——引发公众愤慨或道德谴责的事件

coreImage: 一个人在公共场合踩到香蕉皮滑倒了——周围所有人的第一反应是"天哪"，第二反应是压低声音传给别人。scandal本质上是"秘密被公开后的社会围观"：本来关着门的事，门忽然被撞开，闪光灯噼里啪啦。它不是罪行本身，是罪行被看见后空气里的嗡嗡声。

semanticRadii.label: 公共事件
semanticRadii.example: A major accounting scandal erupted at the telecom giant.

semanticRadii.label: 个人声誉
semanticRadii.structure: his reputation was ruined by scandal
semanticRadii.example: Her promising career was cut short by scandal.

semanticRadii.label: 口语夸张
semanticRadii.example: It's a scandal that teachers are paid so little.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 事件搭配：a scandal breaks/erupts/unfolds。人的反应：cover up a scandal（掩盖）；expose/uncover a scandal（揭露）。口语句式：it's an absolute scandal that…（太不像话了）。修饰语：major, huge, national, juicy（八卦语境）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She was implicated in a bribery scandal and had to resign from her cabinet post.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 个人后果——丑闻的职业生涯代价。

exampleDiagnoses.example: In a small town, even a minor scandal — like the mayor's nephew getting a parking ticket waived — can dominate conversation for weeks.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 尺度感——scandal大到推翻政府、小到街头巷议。

synonymComparisons.difference: 争议，不一定道德有问题
synonymComparisons.example: The policy change sparked controversy among educators.

synonymComparisons.difference: 彻底搞砸的事情，偏失败/闹剧
synonymComparisons.example: The product launch was a complete fiasco.

synonymComparisons.difference: 引发愤怒的行为/事件
synonymComparisons.example: The verdict sparked public outrage.

synonymComparisons.difference: 耻辱/不光彩，侧重状态或评价
synonymComparisons.example: He brought disgrace on the entire family.

oneLinePenetration: scandal = 秘密被公开 + 道德瑕疵 + 社会围观。没有观众就没有scandal。一件见不得人的事关在门里是秘密，推到广场上才是scandal。所以scandal的燃料从来不是"做了什么"，而是"被多少人知道了"。

posNote: 稀缺；不足——资源相对于需求严重缺乏

forms.note: 稀缺；不足——资源相对于需求严重缺乏

coreImage: 沙漠里最后一瓶水分给十个人——每一滴都有名字，每个人都在计算别人抿了多少。钻石贵不是因为硬，是因为少。限时抢购的倒计时跳一下，肾上腺素就飙一下：物以稀为贵的反义词是泛滥成灾。scarcity让选择变得血腥，也让文明长了计算的脑——经济学就建立在"不够"上面。

semanticRadii.label: 市场/定价
semanticRadii.example: Luxury brands create artificial scarcity to maintain prices.

semanticRadii.label: 劳动力
semanticRadii.example: The scarcity of software engineers has driven up salaries.

semanticRadii.label: 时间/注意力
semanticRadii.example: The scarcity of time forced her to make difficult choices.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 标准搭配：a scarcity of sth；scarcity + in/of area。常用形容词：acute, severe, increasing, relative。economics核心概念：the law of scarcity（稀缺定律）。可与mindset连用：a scarcity mindset（稀缺心态）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Diamond engagement rings are a triumph of marketing over actual scarcity.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 消费主义批判——人为稀缺 vs 真实稀缺。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Growing up in poverty taught her a scarcity mindset that made it hard to enjoy abundance later.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 心理层面——稀缺如何塑造思维习惯。

synonymComparisons.difference: 暂时性缺货/不足，可缓解
synonymComparisons.example: There's a shortage of nurses in rural hospitals.

synonymComparisons.difference: 中性，单纯缺少
synonymComparisons.example: The project failed due to a lack of funding.

synonymComparisons.difference: 极严重，特指粮食/饥荒
synonymComparisons.example: The region suffered a devastating famine.

synonymComparisons.difference: 书面语，同lack但更正式
synonymComparisons.example: There is a dearth of reliable data on the topic.

oneLinePenetration: scarcity ≠ shortage。shortage是"这一季产量不够"，scarcity是"这东西本来就不够，永远不够"。经济学把scarcity写在第一章——它不是临时的，是人类的基本处境。稀缺从不消失，只转移形式。

posNote: 轻蔑；鄙视——居高临下地看不起

forms.note: 轻蔑；鄙视——居高临下地看不起

coreImage: 有人在讨论会上提出一个笨拙的回答，你连"不对"都懒得说——嘴角往下弯了一毫米，目光移开半秒，像在看一只跑错了跑道的蚂蚁。scorn不带愤怒，它更冷——像冰，不是火。愤怒还承认对方是"对手"；scorn直接把对方划入"你配不配"的名单之外。

semanticRadii.label: 拒绝行为
semanticRadii.example: She rejected the bribe with scorn.

semanticRadii.label: 表达方式
semanticRadii.example: He replied with a scornful laugh.

semanticRadii.label: 谚语固定
semanticRadii.example: The proverb says fools scorn the wisdom they can't understand.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 名词：pour/heap scorn on sb/sth（猛烈抨击/嘲讽）。动词及物：scorn + sb/sth；scorn + to do sth（不屑于做）。态度描写：a scornful glance/laugh/smile/tone；patently scornful。不及物时有被动结构中：be scorned by。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He scorned the easy path, choosing instead to build his company without investor money.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 有原则的鄙视——scorn可以是一种价值观姿态。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The old professor's scorn for lazy thinking was legendary: he'd hand back essays with nothing but question marks.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: scorn作为驱动高标准的力量。

synonymComparisons.difference: 更冷更绝对的法律/道德层面
synonymComparisons.example: She felt nothing but contempt for the corrupt official.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏"不屑一顾"，不直接表达
synonymComparisons.example: He looked at fast food with disdain and insisted on fine dining.

synonymComparisons.difference: 公开嘲讽/取笑，有时带表演感
synonymComparisons.example: His speech was met with hoots of derision.

synonymComparisons.difference: 模仿/戏弄，偏行动和外显
synonymComparisons.example: The comedian's mockery of the politician went viral.

oneLinePenetration: scorn = 蔑视 + 拒绝互动。它不是"我恨你"——恨是需要能量的；scorn是"你不存在，你的意见不值得用任何感情去处理"。火烧得快灭得也快，冰只是不动——但冻死你的速度不比火烧慢。

posNote: 仔细审查；审视——深入细致的检查

forms.note: 仔细审查；审视——深入细致的检查

coreImage: 机场安检把你包里的每样东西翻出来摆在台面上——不是怀疑你，是规矩如此。古董鉴定师对着一只明代瓷碗看了一个小时，用放大镜一寸一寸地移：真假就在这道冰裂纹里。scrutiny是把东西放到聚光灯下，不是因为不信任，是因为"信"本身需要通过"看"来确认。真相怕光？不，谎言才怕光。

semanticRadii.label: 法律/审查
semanticRadii.example: The court applied strict scrutiny to the new law's validity.

semanticRadii.label: 财务/账目
semanticRadii.example: The company's accounts are subject to annual regulatory scrutiny.

semanticRadii.label: 科学/学术
semanticRadii.example: All papers undergo rigorous peer scrutiny before publication.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 标准搭配：come under scrutiny；be subjected to scrutiny；face scrutiny。常用修饰：close, intense, careful, critical, public。动词形式：scrutinize sth for signs of sth。不用于日常琐事（如"仔细看菜单"用check更自然）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: A good journalist submits every source to rigorous scrutiny before publishing.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 职业美德——审慎是负责任的标志。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Her application was scrutinized for any hint of inconsistency, which she found both exhausting and reassuring.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 两面性——被审查的压力与被认真对待的认可。

synonymComparisons.difference: 表面/视觉检查，偏机械
synonymComparisons.example: The mechanic did a quick inspection of the car.

synonymComparisons.difference: 财务/合规审计，偏制度性
synonymComparisons.example: The IRS conducted a tax audit of the company.

synonymComparisons.difference: 通用"检查"，最中性
synonymComparisons.example: He underwent a thorough medical examination.

synonymComparisons.difference: 审阅/评估，可长可短
synonymComparisons.example: The book got mixed reviews from critics.

oneLinePenetration: scrutiny = 系统性 + 深入性 + 找问题。inspection是"看一遍"，scrutiny是"看穿"。它的对象通常是人的行为、企业的账目、政策的效果——不是物，是人和制度。scrutiny是民主制度里的刹车片：权力越大，scrutiny越强。

posNote: 隔离；分开——将不同群体或事物强行分离

forms.note: 隔离；分开——将不同群体或事物强行分离
被隔离的；实行种族隔离的

coreImage: 水龙头下一动不动的肥皂——油往左聚、水往右聚，绝不相融。segregate就是把社会的"油"和"水"倒进两个杯子，说"你们不要碰"。它在历史上有一张出名的脸：公交车上画一条线，一面坐白人、一面坐黑人。把人分成不同队列——不是按身高、是按"你属于哪一类"。

semanticRadii.label: 功能/物理
semanticRadii.example: Residents are required to segregate waste into recyclable categories.

semanticRadii.label: 数据/系统
semanticRadii.example: Sensitive customer data must be segregated from public datasets.

semanticRadii.label: 逻辑推断
semanticRadii.example: It's crucial to segregate reliable data from speculation in research.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 标准搭配：segregate sb/sth from sb/sth；segregate sb/sth by 标准。常用被动：be segregated based on / by。社会语境高度敏感：通常暗示不公正。非社会语境为中性：segregate flammable materials from heat sources。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The database architect designed the system to segregate user identities from behavioral data for privacy compliance.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 数据架构——中性的功能性分隔。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The prison report found that inmates were informally segregated into gangs that controlled different cell blocks.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 当代社会问题——隔离作为权力结构。

synonymComparisons.difference: 最通用，中性/无价值观
synonymComparisons.example: Please separate the whites from the colors before washing.

synonymComparisons.difference: 孤立个体，切断联系
synonymComparisons.example: The infected patient was isolated from others.

synonymComparisons.difference: 排除，挡在外面
synonymComparisons.example: He felt excluded from the conversation.

synonymComparisons.difference: 物理/行政划分（如分区）
synonymComparisons.example: The conference room was partitioned into smaller spaces.

oneLinePenetration: segregate = 按类别切割 + 系统性 + 通常不公正。separate是"你把那两个苹果分开"，segregate是"法律规定那个种族的孩子不能进这个学校"。前者是物理动作，后者是社会操作。segregate的罪不在于"分"，在于"凭什么分"和"分了的后果"。

posNote: 抓住；夺取；把握——用力、快速、果断地获取

forms.note: 抓住；夺取；把握——用力、快速、果断地获取
夺取；没收；（医学）癫痫发作

coreImage: 球传到禁区——不是等它停下来，是它在空中还没落稳就一脚抽了出去。机会的窗只会开一瞬：犹豫？窗就关了。seize不是"得到"，是"抢得到"。像警察冲进屋抓住逃犯的手腕——不快就跑了；像直觉在你还能说"等等"之前已经做了决定。seize不礼貌、不优雅，但它有效。

semanticRadii.label: 权力/控制
semanticRadii.example: The military seized control of the capital in a midnight coup.

semanticRadii.label: 物理抓住
semanticRadii.example: He seized her by the arm and pulled her away from the edge.

semanticRadii.label: 法律没收
semanticRadii.example: Customs officials seized a shipment of counterfeit goods.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 核心搭配：seize + the opportunity/moment/day/chance。夺取义：seize power/control/territory；被动：power was seized。法律没收：常用于被动（assets were seized）；seize sb's passport。身体动作结构：seize sb by the + 身体部位（the arm, the throat）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The rebels seized control of the broadcast station and aired their demands to the nation.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 权力夺取——控制信息就是控制叙事。

exampleDiagnoses.example: A sudden panic seized him as he realized he'd left his passport in the taxi.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 情感用法——被强烈情绪suddenly抓住。

synonymComparisons.difference: 快速抓/抢，口语，随意
synonymComparisons.example: He grabbed a sandwich and ran.

synonymComparisons.difference: 紧握/理解，可推物理也可推抽象
synonymComparisons.example: She grasped the concept quickly.

synonymComparisons.difference: 因害怕/紧张死死抓住
synonymComparisons.example: He clutched his mother's hand in the dark.

synonymComparisons.difference: 俘获/捕获，偏"使对方失去自由"
synonymComparisons.example: The soldiers captured the enemy commander.

oneLinePenetration: seize = 主动性 + 快速果断 + 不等待许可。它最区别于grab在于"不靠蛮力，靠判断速度"。seize the day不是"把一天抢过来"，是"不等明天来替你选择"。对象通常是机会、权力，或者失控的情绪——它们都不等人。

posNote: 感觉；轰动——生理感知或引发巨大公众反应的事物

forms.note: 感觉；轰动——生理感知或引发巨大公众反应的事物
用耸人听闻的手法处理

coreImage: 手指碰到刚出炉的盘子——还没想"烫"，本能已经缩手了。神经传到大脑的速度比意识快0.3秒。同一天，一封举报信让整个公司炸开了锅，从茶水间到董事会，每个人都在传。sensation有两张脸：一张是皮肤上的电流，一张是社会神经上的波澜。一张你一个人承受，另一张是所有人一起承受。

semanticRadii.label: 轰动事件
semanticRadii.example: The young pianist caused a sensation at the competition.

semanticRadii.label: 媒体语境
semanticRadii.example: Tabloids rely on sensational headlines to sell copies.

semanticRadii.label: 口语夸张
semanticRadii.example: His first single made him an overnight sensation.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: 感知义：a sensation of + 名词（warmth, cold, dizziness, numbness）。轰动义：cause/create/become a sensation；the media sensation。修饰语：overwhelming, strange, pleasant, sharp 修饰生理感。sensational不修饰生理感，只修饰"哄动程度"——a sensational performance。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The painting's debut caused a sensation, with critics calling it either genius or garbage.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 艺术轰动——两极分化的关注。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He was an overnight sensation on YouTube, then invisible again within three months.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 网络时代——名声速来速去。

synonymComparisons.difference: 最泛，可感情也可物理
synonymComparisons.example: I have a strange feeling about this place.

synonymComparisons.difference: 侧重认知层面的感知/理解
synonymComparisons.example: Visual perception involves complex brain processes.

synonymComparisons.difference: 情绪上的兴奋/激动
synonymComparisons.example: The crowd buzzed with excitement before the concert.

synonymComparisons.difference: 轻微轰动，偏"引起群议"
synonymComparisons.example: His arrival caused a slight stir among the guests.

oneLinePenetration: sensation = 信号从外围传入中心。在身体上，是从神经末梢到大脑；在社会里，是从一个人传到所有人。它的本质是一个信息抵达后引发的连锁反应。轰动不过是"感觉"的放大版——当一个故事碰对了所有人的神经。

posNote: 情绪；观点；感伤——基于情感的态度或看法

forms.note: 情绪；观点；感伤——基于情感的态度或看法

coreImage: 外婆的老花镜在抽屉里躺了十年——你每次打开抽屉都看到，但上周搬家整理时才突然坐下哭了五分钟。sentiment不是那一刻的眼泪，是十年里你每次打开抽屉时隐约存在的那个"东西"。它不是即时的情绪——是沉淀下来的态度。像酒留在杯底的印记，干了还在。

semanticRadii.label: 市场信心
semanticRadii.example: Consumer sentiment plunged to a record low in the recession.

semanticRadii.label: 个人感情
semanticRadii.example: "You deserve a raise." "My sentiments exactly."

semanticRadii.label: 情感价值
semanticRadii.example: The watch has little monetary value but great sentimental value.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: 态度义：express/share/echo a sentiment。市场义：consumer/investor/market sentiment；shifts in sentiment。情感义：a sentiment of + 名词（gratitude, regret, nostalgia）。sentimental用于修饰人对事物的过度感情投入，常带贬义。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The policy was well-intentioned but out of touch with public sentiment.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 治理语境——与民意脱节。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She kept the ticket stub for sentimental reasons, though the movie itself was utterly forgettable.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 私人情感——物的价值不在物本身。

synonymComparisons.difference: 当下的具体情绪体验
synonymComparisons.example: He struggled to control his emotions during the speech.

synonymComparisons.difference: 比emotion更泛，可包括身体感觉
synonymComparisons.example: I got the feeling he was hiding something.

synonymComparisons.difference: 理性思考后的观点，少情感成分
synonymComparisons.example: What's your opinion on the new policy?

synonymComparisons.difference: 弥漫性的情绪状态，不针对特定对象
synonymComparisons.example: She's in a good mood today.

oneLinePenetration: sentiment介于feeling和opinion之间。它不是当下的情绪爆发，也不是纯理性判断——它是一种以情感为基础形成的稳定立场。一个人在投票时说的"我就是不喜欢这个候选人"，这不是观点，是sentiment。观点可以辩论，sentiment很难——它不是想出来的，是泡出来的。

posNote: 宁静的；安详的；平静的——不受干扰的深层平静

forms.note: 宁静的；安详的；平静的——不受干扰的深层平静

coreImage: 清晨湖面没有一丝风，水面如镜，倒映雪山和松林，水鸟游过只留下银色细线——不打破完整的安宁。不是死寂，而是"万物各在其位，世界不必言语"的通透。老人坐在长椅上喂鸽子，阳光穿过银杏叶洒在肩头，脸上没有焦虑、没有急切——那种从眼睛里透出来的平静，就是serene。

semanticRadii.label: 风景/环境
semanticRadii.example: We found a serene spot by the river for our picnic.

semanticRadii.label: 心态/心境
semanticRadii.example: He faced the critics with serene confidence.

semanticRadii.label: 生活/氛围
semanticRadii.example: The monastery offered a serene retreat from city noise.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: remain/stay serene；feel serene；look serene。固定搭配：serene confidence（从容自信），serene beauty（宁静之美）。常用修饰：perfectly serene, utterly serene, surprisingly serene。不用于"无聊"或"空旷"——空停车场是empty不是serene，必须有审美/精神维度。

exampleDiagnoses.example: After the storm passed, the ocean became strangely serene.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 自然描写——风暴后异常宁静，张力强。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She has a serene confidence that makes everyone trust her judgment.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 性格描写——serene confidence是最优雅的力量表达。

synonymComparisons.difference: 风平浪静、情绪稳定（偏表面/应急）
synonymComparisons.example: Stay calm — everything is under control.

synonymComparisons.difference: 没有冲突/打扰的平和（偏环境）
synonymComparisons.example: It's so peaceful here in the countryside.

synonymComparisons.difference: 环境静谧安宁（诗意程度更高）
synonymComparisons.example: The garden was tranquil in the early morning.

synonymComparisons.difference: 刻意控制情绪后的镇定
synonymComparisons.example: She remained composed during the interrogation.

oneLinePenetration: serene = 内心深处的澄澈安宁（精神厚度），calm = 表面没慌/没乱（情绪管理），peaceful = 没有冲突/嘈杂（环境）。暴风雨中一个人可以是serene的，但窗外绝不peaceful。

posNote: 切断；断绝——用决定性力量完全断开

forms.note: 切断；断绝——用决定性力量完全断开

coreImage: 一把刀切腊肠——刚开始松松的，切到筋的时候得使劲、手腕一拧，"啪"一声断了。从那以后，切开的两个截面可以贴在一起，但再也不通了。sever不是"暂停联系"，是"血管截断、神经末梢各自坏死"。像删了前任的号码——不是拉黑，是从通讯录和记忆里同时执行删除命令。

semanticRadii.label: 物理切断
semanticRadii.example: The accident nearly severed his left hand.

semanticRadii.label: 法律/合同
semanticRadii.example: The court ruled to sever the invalid clause from the contract.

semanticRadii.label: 网络/通讯
semanticRadii.example: The storm severed the island's only undersea cable.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 标准搭配：sever + ties/relations/connections/contact。物理义：sever a limb/artery/nerve/tendon。sever sth from sth：sever the head from the body。名词形式：severance pay（遣散费）；severance of diplomatic relations。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The cable snapped and severed a power line, plunging three neighborhoods into darkness.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 物理断裂——一刀切后果。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He severed himself from every community that had shaped him, believing radical independence was the price of authenticity.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 哲学意味——自我放逐式的断绝。

synonymComparisons.difference: 最通用，任何切割
synonymComparisons.example: She cut the cake into eight slices.

synonymComparisons.difference: 分离/拆下，可逆
synonymComparisons.example: He detached the trailer from the truck.

synonymComparisons.difference: 断开连接，偏非物理/通讯
synonymComparisons.example: I disconnected the phone line.

synonymComparisons.difference: 特指截肢医疗手术
synonymComparisons.example: The surgeon had to amputate his leg below the knee.

oneLinePenetration: sever比cut重、比detach决绝。cut是技术动作，sever是法律宣布。sever ties不是"暂时不联系"——是"把桥炸了"。它的核心是"不再有恢复的可能"：切口干净，但之后的空缺是永久的。

posNote: 盾牌；防护物；保护——挡住攻击或伤害

forms.note: 盾牌；防护物；保护——挡住攻击或伤害

coreImage: 中世纪骑士左手举盾——不是不挨打，是"你先打盾，等你累了再打你"。现代人举着隐私设置和密码管理器冲进互联网，挡的是看不见的箭。妈妈本能伸手挡在孩子脸前，快的根本没经过思考。shield的精髓不是"没有伤害"，是"伤害在这停"。盾在你前面，你听得见石子在铁皮上叮当响——但它穿不过来。

semanticRadii.label: 隐喻保护
semanticRadii.example: Her attorney tried to shield her from aggressive questioning.

semanticRadii.label: 法律/财务
semanticRadii.example: Offshore accounts were used to shield assets from taxation.

semanticRadii.label: 技术/电磁
semanticRadii.example: The server room is surrounded by an electromagnetic shield.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 动词搭配：shield sb/sth from/against sth。名词搭配：act as/serve as/provide a shield against。shield一词本身是保护，不暗示保护方式。可被动：be shielded from。隐喻式：shield sb's eyes from the sun。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The company's complex corporate structure was designed to shield executives from personal liability.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 法律/道德灰区——保护可作为挡箭牌。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She raised a hand to shield her eyes from the glare, squinting toward the horizon.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 物理场景——简单却传神的描写。

synonymComparisons.difference: 最通用，任何形式的保护
synonymComparisons.example: Wear sunscreen to protect your skin.

synonymComparisons.difference: 对抗攻击，有战斗感
synonymComparisons.example: They defended the castle against invaders.

synonymComparisons.difference: 预防性保护，偏"保障机制"
synonymComparisons.example: Regulations safeguard consumers from fraud.

synonymComparisons.difference: 过滤/筛选式遮挡
synonymComparisons.example: The trees screened the house from the road.
