items: viable 作形容词，常用搭配：a viable option/alternative/solution/plan/proposal/business/candidate。常见结构：make sth viable, prove viable, remain viable, be economically/financially/commercially viable。否定形式 non-viable 比 unviable 更常见。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The proposal sounds ambitious, but is it financially viable in the long term?
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: financially viable 追问的是"经济可持续性"，这是商业场景中的高频审问句式。

exampleDiagnoses.example: After the accident, doctors fought to keep the patient viable for organ donation.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: viable 此处取其医学"可存活/可维持生命"义，极其严肃。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Without public support, the reform plan is simply not politically viable.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: politically viable 强调"在政治上有生存空间"，是政治分析常用组合。

synonymComparisons.difference: 近义，但 feasible 偏技术可行性，viable 偏生存能力
synonymComparisons.example: A project can be technically feasible but not commercially viable.

synonymComparisons.difference: 更口语化，强调"能用就行"，viable 更正式有生存意味
synonymComparisons.example: The prototype is workable, but we need to prove it's viable at scale.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调实际操作层面，不强调能否存活
synonymComparisons.example: It's a practical approach, but not a viable long-term strategy.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调持续维持，viable 只到"能存活"的门槛
synonymComparisons.example: A viable startup may not yet be a sustainable business.

oneLinePenetration: viable 衡量的是跨越"存活线"的最低条件——不是最优，不是最好，而是"能不能活"。

forms.note: 充满活力的；鲜亮的；振动的

coreImage: 把手机调成静音，但它还是在桌上嗡嗡地振动——vibrate 是一种看不见的、但你能感觉到的能量传递。琴弦被拨动后持续颤动、声波穿过空气让你的耳膜共振、一个人说话时语气中的激动让周围的人都感受到一种张力。vibrate 讲的是"物体在平衡位置附近来回快速振荡"，但引申出去，它也是"情感共鸣"的物理原型。

semanticRadii.label: 声音共鸣
semanticRadii.meaning: 声音颤抖；带着情感起伏
semanticRadii.example: Her voice vibrated with anger as she recounted the incident.

semanticRadii.label: 氛围共鸣
semanticRadii.example: The stadium vibrated with the roar of eighty thousand fans.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 不及物用法：sth vibrates（物体自身振动）。及物用法少见，通常用使役：make sth vibrate。常用搭配：vibrate with excitement/anger/energy（因情绪或能量而颤动/回荡）。注意：形容手机"震动"用 vibrate（或 go off / buzz），不是 shake。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The entire building vibrated when the subway passed underneath.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 不及物用法，强调"整栋楼作为一个整体因外力而震动"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: His voice vibrated with a mixture of indignation and sorrow.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: vibrated with + 情绪名词，表示"声音因情绪而颤抖"，高级文学表达。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The club vibrated with bass so deep you could feel it in your chest.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 借"物理振动"形容氛围，让读者能"感受"到低音而非仅仅"听到"。

synonymComparisons.difference: 泛指摇晃/抖动，剧烈程度可大可小
synonymComparisons.example: vibrate 是快速微小往复，shake 可以是大幅摇晃（shake the bottle vs. the phone vibrates）

synonymComparisons.difference: 主体为人或生物因恐惧/冷/紧张而颤抖
synonymComparisons.example: He trembled with fear, while the phone simply vibrated on the table.

synonymComparisons.difference: 物理/数学语境，正式术语，指规律的周期性摆动
synonymComparisons.example: A pendulum oscillates; a cell phone vibrates.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调"产生共鸣"，是振动引发的结果而非振动本身
synonymComparisons.example: The speech resonated with the audience because his voice vibrated with sincerity.

oneLinePenetration: vibrate 是"看不见的能量传递"——物体在抖、声音在颤、空间在震，全部指向同一种快速往复的律动。

coreImage: 一只被逼到角落的流浪狗露出牙齿，喉咙里发出低吼——那不是普通的凶，那是一种不带犹豫的、纯粹的恶狠狠。vicious 形容的攻击往往是突然的、毫无保留的、几乎是出于本能的。它也形容言辞：一句 vicious gossip 可以比一拳更伤人，因为它直指你最脆弱的地方。vicious 没有温度，没有怜悯。

semanticRadii.label: 言辞伤人
semanticRadii.example: She spread a vicious rumor that destroyed his career.

semanticRadii.label: 循环困境
semanticRadii.example: Poverty and poor education form a vicious circle that is hard to break.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: vicious 只能作形容词。固定搭配：vicious circle/cycle（恶性循环）几乎是固定词组，不可拆分。注意 vicious 不能用于形容"味道辛辣"或"困难"——不能说 a vicious exam，应说 a tough/difficult exam。vicious 有道德谴责的意味。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The victim suffered a vicious beating that left him in intensive care.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: vicious beating 形容"殴打"的残忍程度，强调人为施加的暴力。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The political debate descended into a vicious exchange of personal insults.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: vicious exchange 表示"恶毒的交锋"，超越正常辩论的边界。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Borrowing money to pay off debts only perpetuates a vicious circle.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: vicious circle 固定搭配，表示"越陷越深的恶性循环"。

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调原始野性、未开化的粗暴
synonymComparisons.example: vicious 可以是有预谋的，savage 更像不受控制的兽性（a savage beast vs. a vicious plot）

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调极端的残忍和冷酷无情
synonymComparisons.example: The treatment of prisoners was brutal, but the personal gossip was merely vicious.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调主观恶意和蓄意伤害，不一定涉及暴力
synonymComparisons.example: vicious 有暴力维度，malicious 重在"用心歹毒"（malicious intent vs. vicious attack）

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调凶猛激烈，常用于动物或自然力量
synonymComparisons.example: A ferocious storm, a vicious dog — both intense but in different registers.

oneLinePenetration: vicious 是把"凶"字拉满——要么在肉体上不留余地，要么在言语上不留情面，要么在循环中不留出口。

coreImage: 一场车祸后，被撞的路人躺在地上，他是事故的 victim——不是他的错，但他承受了全部后果。victim 这个词的底层画面永远是"被动承受"：灾难降临在你身上，你什么都没做错，甚至什么都没做，但你承担了代价。它后来引申到了更广阔的领域——诈骗的受害者、体制的牺牲品、甚至自我标榜的"受害者心态"。

semanticRadii.label: 社会/制度
semanticRadii.example: She saw herself as a victim of systemic discrimination.

semanticRadii.label: 心理/修辞
semanticRadii.example: Stop playing the victim and take responsibility for your actions.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 常用结构：victim of + 造成伤害的事物（be the victim of a crime / a victim of circumstance / fall victim to）。fall victim to 是高频固定搭配（Many small businesses fell victim to the recession）。play the victim 带有贬义，指"摆出受害者的姿态以博取同情或推卸责任"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The fund was set up to compensate victims of the terrorist attack.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: victims of + 事件，复数 victims 指向所有受影响的人。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He fell victim to a sophisticated online scam and lost his life savings.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: fall victim to 固定搭配"沦为...的受害者"，不能替换为 become a victim。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She refuses to be seen as a victim and insists on being called a survivor.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: victim vs. survivor 是现代观念的对立：被动承受 vs. 主动走出来。

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调伤亡人数统计，偏军事/灾难，比 victim 更无情
synonymComparisons.example: A soldier killed is a casualty; a civilian targeted is a victim.

synonymComparisons.difference: 经历了灾难但活下来的人，是 victim 的"积极转化"
synonymComparisons.example: She was a victim of the attack, but she became a survivor.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调被选中/瞄准，有"成为目标"的主动性暗示
synonymComparisons.example: The company was the target of a cyberattack; its customers became the victims.

synonymComparisons.difference: 为信仰或事业而牺牲，有主动选择的英雄意味
synonymComparisons.example: A martyr chooses to die for a cause; a victim has no choice.

oneLinePenetration: victim 的核心是"被动承受"——命运选中了你，不是你选择了命运。

coreImage: 深夜的哨兵站在岗楼上，眼睛不眨地盯着黑暗中的每一个动静。vigilant 不是"害怕"，而是"清醒地守候"——你知道危险可能来，但不让它趁你不备。vigilant 的张力在于持续：不是一瞬间的反应，而是长时间保持对潜在威胁的敏感。一个 vigilant 的家长不会禁止孩子上网，但她会知道孩子在看什么。

semanticRadii.label: 监管审查
semanticRadii.example: The agency maintains vigilant oversight of food safety standards.

semanticRadii.label: 日常警觉
semanticRadii.example: Parents need to be vigilant about their children's online activity.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 常用结构：remain/stay vigilant（保持警惕）、be vigilant about/against（对...保持警觉）、keep a vigilant eye on（密切注视）。注意：vigilant 是状态形容词，描述一种持续的警觉状态，不等同于 alert（一瞬间的警觉反应）。常见搭配：vigilant citizen / vigilant neighbor / vigilant watch。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Despite years without incident, the security team remained vigilant around the clock.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: remained vigilant 强调"在长期平静中仍不放松"，这是 vigilant 的核心语境。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Health authorities are urging the public to be vigilant about new flu symptoms.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: be vigilant about + 具体风险，给出"需要警觉什么"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: A vigilant neighbor noticed the smoke and called the fire department before it spread.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: vigilant neighbor 是经典搭配，描述"细心警觉的邻居"。

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调"机敏地注意到"，偏瞬间反应；vigilant 偏持续守候
synonymComparisons.example: The guard was alert enough to hear the noise, but only the vigilant patrol kept us safe all night.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调"有戒心的、提防的"，带有顾虑情绪
synonymComparisons.example: She was wary of strangers, but the police asked everyone to be vigilant.

synonymComparisons.difference: 与 vigilant 最近义，但 watchful 更日常、更中性
synonymComparisons.example: A watchful parent keeps an eye on the playground; a vigilant one knows the signs of trouble.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调专注注意，但不一定针对危险
synonymComparisons.example: A vigilant guard watches for threats; an attentive waiter watches for empty glasses.

oneLinePenetration: vigilant 是在太平无事时也不合眼的警觉——不是恐惧，而是持续的清醒。

coreImage: 一条醒目的红线被画在地上，所有人都知道不能跨——但偏偏有人一脚踩过去。violate 讲的就是"跨过那条不该跨的线"。它可以是违反法律条文、侵犯他人的私人空间、亵渎神圣之物，也可以是背叛信任。共同点在于：有一个明确边界存在，而你选择无视它，走了进去，造成了破坏。

semanticRadii.label: 侵犯权利
semanticRadii.example: The surveillance program was found to violate citizens' privacy rights.

semanticRadii.label: 亵渎神圣
semanticRadii.example: The soldiers violated the temple, leaving it in ruins.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: violate 是及物动词，宾语可以是法律、规则、协议、权利、隐私、边界、信任等抽象名词。常用被动：be in violation of（处于违反...的状态）。常见搭配：violate the terms of agreement, violate human rights, violate one's trust, violate sacred ground。语气正式且严重。

exampleDiagnoses.example: By leaking classified documents, he flagrantly violated his oath of office.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: flagrantly violated 表示"公然违反"，强调违规的肆无忌惮。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The construction project violated multiple zoning regulations and was shut down.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: violated 后接具体法规，是最典型的法律/行政语境。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Reading her diary without permission violated her trust more than her privacy.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: violated trust 是"侵犯信任"，比侵犯隐私更深层的情感伤害。

synonymComparisons.difference: 与 violate 近义，但 breach 偏"打破"（动词/名词均可）
synonymComparisons.example: violate a law vs. breach a contract — 法律体系更常与 violate 搭配

synonymComparisons.difference: 侧重"侵犯权利"，尤其是知识产权
synonymComparisons.example: A patent is infringed, but human rights are violated.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调"越界"，带有道德/宗教色彩
synonymComparisons.example: violate 是人为规则的违反，transgress 常指逾越道德/宗教戒律

synonymComparisons.difference: 字面义"闯入他人土地"，引申义有"冒犯越界"意味
synonymComparisons.example: You trespass on private property, but you violate someone's privacy.

oneLinePenetration: violate 的核心画面是"一条界线被踩碎了"——界在，人越，后果生。

forms.note: 精湛技艺（特指艺术领域）

coreImage: 古希腊哲学家认为美德不是天生的，而是反复练习的结果——就像肌肉一样，每一次对诱惑说"不"、每一次在没有人看见时仍然做正确的事，都是在为 virtue 增加一克重量。virtue 的东西方交汇点在于：它不是空洞的道德标签，而是一个人在无人监督时选择的姿态。它是勇敢、正直、克制的集合体，也是"这件工具最大的优点"这个实用主义的表达。

semanticRadii.label: 优点/好处
semanticRadii.example: The virtue of this design is its simplicity.

semanticRadii.label: 凭借/由于
semanticRadii.example: She got the job by virtue of her extensive experience rather than her degree.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 固定介词搭配：by virtue of = because of / as a result of（正式书面语，表达因果关系）。常见搭配：extol the virtues of（赞扬...的优点）、a woman of virtue（有德行的女子）、make a virtue of necessity（把不得已的事装成自愿）。注意：virtue 作"贞洁"解时属于旧式用法。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He was promoted by virtue of his seniority, not his competence.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: by virtue of 正式因果表达，"由于/凭借"，不可用 due to 随意替换。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The speaker extolled the virtues of hard work and perseverance.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: extol the virtues of 是固定搭配，"大肆赞扬...的美德/好处"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Honesty is not just a virtue; it is the foundation of all lasting relationships.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 把 virtue 置于更高框架中讨论，不是孤立的道德标签而是关系基石。

synonymComparisons.difference: 道德体系、是非观的整体概念，virtue 是其中的具体品质
synonymComparisons.example: Stealing violates morality; honesty is one virtue within that moral system.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调"诚实正直、表里如一"，是一种完整的人格状态
synonymComparisons.example: Virtue is a quality you possess; integrity is who you are when no one is watching.

synonymComparisons.difference: 优点、价值，偏重"值得奖励/承认"的属性
synonymComparisons.example: The virtue of this plan is its efficiency; its merit lies in the results it has achieved.

synonymComparisons.difference: 泛指善良，更口语化且范围更宽
synonymComparisons.example: virtue 在道德语境中更正式，goodness 更日常（She is full of goodness, but patience is her greatest virtue）

oneLinePenetration: virtue 有两张面孔——一张朝向天空，是让人仰望的品格高度；一张朝向地面，是一把工具最实用的那个功能。

coreImage: 日出前的山峦轮廓模糊不清，天一亮，山的形状渐渐 visible——从混沌中浮现，变成眼睛能确认的存在。visible 的核心体验是"由暗到明"：不是事物不存在，而是你的视线终于抵达了它。城市的雾霾降低 visibility，CEO 的离职影响公司在公众中的 visibility。从物理到社会，可见性是存在的宣言。

semanticRadii.label: 社会关注
semanticRadii.meaning: 引人注目的；有存在感的
semanticRadii.example: The police maintained a visible presence throughout the event.

semanticRadii.label: 数据表现
semanticRadii.example: Poor visibility forced the airport to cancel several flights.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 常用结构：be/become visible to sb, barely/hardly/scarcely visible（几乎看不见）, clearly/highly visible（非常明显）, visible from a distance（从远处可见）。make oneself visible 可表示"露个面让人看到"。注意：visible 不作前置定语强调"看得见的"时，更偏向"明显的/有目共睹的"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The stars are only visible when you get far enough away from city lights.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: visible 作表语，强调"能够被看见"的条件性。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The company needs a more visible leader who can inspire public confidence.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: visible 在此意为"高调/有存在感的"，不单指"被看见"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Her frustration was clearly visible despite her attempt to remain composed.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: was visible 描述"抽象情绪表现在外"，是经典隐喻延伸。

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏"显而易见的、似乎的"，可能只是表面现象
synonymComparisons.example: The damage is visible to the eye, but the underlying cause is not immediately apparent.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏"显眼的、惹人注意的"，有时带负面意味
synonymComparisons.example: She felt conspicuous in her bright red dress at the formal black-tie event.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏"可辨认/可辨别的"，通常需要努力才能看清
synonymComparisons.example: The difference between the two samples is visible at a glance but barely discernible under the microscope.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏科学/客观"可观测到的"，不涉及主观判断
synonymComparisons.example: The planet's orbit is observable through a telescope; it's not always visible to the naked eye.

oneLinePenetration: visible 的本质是"存在进入感知"——事物从黑暗中走进光里，从被忽视变成被看见。

coreImage: 一个盲人恢复了视力，世界对他重新"存在"了——这是 vision 最原始的层面：物理上看见。但马丁·路德·金站在林肯纪念堂前说"I have a dream"的时候，他说的就是 vision 的第二个层面：一种尚未存在但他能看到它应该存在的图景。vision 是连接"现在"和"将来"的眼睛——看得见是因为你想得到，不是因为光足够亮。

semanticRadii.label: 未来愿景
semanticRadii.example: The CEO presented her vision for the company's next decade.

semanticRadii.label: 幻觉异象
semanticRadii.example: In a vision, he saw the path he was meant to follow.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: 常用搭配：have a vision (of/for), share a vision, realize/fulfill a vision, a man/woman of vision（有远见的人）。注意区分：vision 作"视力"不可数，作"愿景/远见"可数（a clear vision）。固定搭配：field of vision（视野）、tunnel vision（目光狭隘；管状视野）、20/20 vision（完美视力）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Without a clear vision, a company drifts aimlessly no matter how talented its staff.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: a clear vision 是商业管理的核心词，"没有愿景就没有方向"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The surgery restored his vision after decades of near-blindness.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: restored vision "恢复视力"，是 vision 最原始的物理义。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She had a vision of a world where every child had access to education.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: a vision of + 想象中的世界，是"未来图景"的经典表达。

synonymComparisons.difference: 生理视觉能力/所见景象，物理性强而无"远见"义
synonymComparisons.example: She lost her sight in the accident, but she never lost her vision for a better future.

synonymComparisons.difference: 侧重"看法、观点"或"风景"
synonymComparisons.example: My vision is to build something lasting; my view is that we should start small.

synonymComparisons.difference: 具体的任务/使命/行动目标
synonymComparisons.example: Vision is where you want to go; mission is what you do to get there.

synonymComparisons.difference: 预见力，强调提前预知的能力，比 vision 更偏预测
synonymComparisons.example: Vision paints what could be; foresight anticipates what will be.

oneLinePenetration: vision 是在没有光的时候也能"看见"的能力——用想象力照亮一个尚未存在的地方。

coreImage: 一个篮球运动员在罚球前闭上眼睛，深呼吸——他在心里把球从指尖出手、划出弧线、穿过篮网的整个过程"看"了一遍。visualize 不是空想，而是"在脑海里放电影"。运动员用它准备比赛，设计师用它呈现数据，学生用它记忆公式。visualize 的力量在于：大脑对"清晰看见的画面"的反应，几乎和对真实事件的反应一样强烈。

semanticRadii.label: 数据呈现
semanticRadii.example: The software helps users visualize complex data through interactive charts.

semanticRadii.label: 具象理解
semanticRadii.example: It's hard to visualize how the finished building will look from these blueprints.

grammarRules.title: 近义词辨析
items: visualize 是及物动词，可接名词、动名词或 wh-从句：visualize success / visualize achieving the goal / visualize what the room will look like。常见搭配：visualize data / visualize the future / visualize a scenario。注意与 imagine 的区别：visualize 更偏"视觉化"，强调"在脑中形成清晰图像"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Before the surgery, the doctor used a 3D model to help the patient visualize the procedure.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: visualize 在此意为"用视觉辅助工具帮人理解/想象"，不完全是心理活动。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She closed her eyes and tried to visualize walking across the stage to receive her diploma.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: visualize + 动作场景，是运动心理学和励志类文本的高频句型。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The dashboard visualizes customer behavior patterns in real time.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: visualize 在此是"用图表呈现"的技术义，主语为物。

synonymComparisons.difference: 泛指所有想象，不限视觉感官
synonymComparisons.example: You can imagine a taste or a sound, but you visualize a scene.

synonymComparisons.difference: 比 visualize 更宏大，多用于未来愿景/蓝图
synonymComparisons.example: We envision a world without poverty — a goal easier to state than to visualize.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调"构思/构想"一个新想法，不一定形成图像
synonymComparisons.example: She conceived the idea on a napkin; later, the designers helped visualize it.

synonymComparisons.difference: 与 visualize 最接近，但更口语化且可以不加刻意努力
synonymComparisons.example: Just picture yourself on a sunny beach — no need to actively visualize every detail.

oneLinePenetration: visualize 是"用眼睛的方式思考"——把抽象变成图像，把未来拉到眼前。

forms.note: 至关重要的；充满活力的；生命的

coreImage: 春天到来，枯黄的草地开始冒出嫩绿，干涸的河床重新有了水流——这就是 vitality 最原始的画面：生命从看起来已死的东西里重新冒出来。vitality 不是"忙"，不是"活跃"，而是生命力本身的涌动。一个九十岁老人眼睛里闪着光，六岁孩子一刻不停地在公园跑——他们之间的共性不是年龄，而是 vitality 的浓度不同。

semanticRadii.label: 文明/经济
semanticRadii.example: The government invests in the arts to sustain the city's cultural vitality.

semanticRadii.label: 抽象属性
semanticRadii.example: The vitality of this ancient tradition lies in its ability to adapt to modern times.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: 不可数名词。常用搭配：full of vitality, burst with vitality, lose vitality, restore vitality, economic/cultural/intellectual vitality。常与 sustain、maintain、lack、restore、breathe 等动词搭配。注意：vitality 不与"身体健康"直接等同——一个人可以健康但缺乏 vitality。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Children radiate a natural vitality that adults often envy and try to recapture.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: radiate vitality "散发活力"，是对 vitality 最具画面感的动词搭配。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The neighborhood's economic vitality depends on attracting new businesses.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: economic vitality "经济活力"，是政策/城市规划领域的高频搭配。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Her writing lacks the vitality it once had; it feels forced and mechanical.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: lacks vitality 形容"缺乏生命力"，可用于艺术批评。

synonymComparisons.difference: 更广的概念，包括物理能量和精力；vitality 更偏"生命力"的质感
synonymComparisons.example: He has enough energy to work 14 hours a day, but his vitality comes from his passion for art.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调"强健有力"，偏身心的力量感
synonymComparisons.example: With renewed vigor, she tackled the project — her vitality inspiring the entire team.

synonymComparisons.difference: 与 vitality 同根但含义不同：生计/谋生手段
synonymComparisons.example: The drought threatened their livelihood but couldn't drain the vitality of the community.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏"生动活泼"，指表情/举止的生气，比 vitality 表浅
synonymComparisons.example: Her animation during the speech showed her excitement, but her vitality runs deeper than any single moment.

oneLinePenetration: vitality 是"生命力的能量密度"——不是你有多少劲，而是你在多深的层面活着。

posNote: 生动的；鲜明的；清晰的——色彩/记忆/描述极为清晰鲜活

forms.note: 生动的；鲜明的；清晰的——色彩/记忆/描述极为清晰鲜活

coreImage: 闭上眼，却清清楚楚看见外婆厨房里蓝白格子桌布、窗台那盆薄荷、锅里咕嘟响的排骨汤——你甚至能闻见那个味道。这不是褪色老照片，而是4K全息投影在脑海里的重播。vivid就是那道让你一睁眼仿佛还在梦里的光线——太清楚了，清楚得不像是回忆，更像重播。

semanticRadii.label: 描述
semanticRadii.example: She gave a vivid account of her travels through Morocco.

semanticRadii.label: 颜色
semanticRadii.example: The garden was filled with vivid red tulips.

semanticRadii.label: 梦境
semanticRadii.example: The medication gave me unusually vivid dreams.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 常用修饰：incredibly vivid, remarkably vivid, so vivid。搭配名词语义场：memory, dream, imagination, description, detail, colour。paint a vivid picture of…（描绘出生动图景）。不修饰声音（不说vivid sound，用clear/sharp）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: I still have a vivid memory of the sunset that evening — gold melting into purple.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 第一人称叙事，画面感强烈，色彩意象。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The warning signs should have been vivid enough for anyone paying attention.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 比喻用法——vivid = 明显/醒目，延伸语义。

synonymComparisons.difference: 有活力的、热闹的（偏行为动态）
synonymComparisons.example: The debate was lively but respectful.

synonymComparisons.difference: 过于清晰直白/露骨（偏负面）
synonymComparisons.example: The documentary contained graphic scenes of the war.

synonymComparisons.difference: 丰富多彩/花哨
synonymComparisons.example: He told a colourful story about his youth in Paris.

synonymComparisons.difference: 思维/表达清晰透彻
synonymComparisons.example: She gave a lucid explanation that anyone could follow.

oneLinePenetration: vivid = 清晰鲜明得仿佛身临其境（中性/褒义），graphic = 细节裸露到令人不适（负面）。一段vivid description让你沉浸，一段graphic description可能让你恶心。vivid是4K画质，graphic是解剖图。

coreImage: 会议室里所有人都在沉默地点头，只有一个人站起来说："我不同意。"这就是 vocal——不是嗓门大，而是"敢于让声音被听见"。vocal 的第一层是物理的"声音"（vocal cords 声带），第二层是态度的"发声"——一个 vocal critic 不会把意见吞进肚子里，一个 vocal minority 不会因为人少就沉默。vocal 的对面不是 quiet，而是 mute。

semanticRadii.label: 公开表态
semanticRadii.meaning: 直言不讳的；大声疾呼的
semanticRadii.example: He has been a vocal advocate for climate change legislation.

semanticRadii.label: 声乐演唱
semanticRadii.example: She provides lead vocals for the band while playing rhythm guitar.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: 形容词用法：be vocal about/in（对...公开表态）、a vocal critic/advocate/opponent/supporter of（...的积极批评/支持者）。注意 vocal 在此义下带有"不畏缩、敢于公开表达"的褒义或中性色彩。名词用法（通常复数 vocals）：lead vocals, backing vocals, sing vocals。vocal cords 是固定术语。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She has been increasingly vocal about the lack of diversity in senior management.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: vocal about + 议题，是典型的职场/政治表达，意为"公开且频繁地批评"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The vocal minority succeeded in blocking the legislation through sustained protest.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: vocal minority "大声疾呼的少数派"，反义词是 silent majority。

exampleDiagnoses.example: His vocal range spans three octaves, which is rare for a male singer.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: vocal range "音域"，回到 vocal 的物理身体义。

synonymComparisons.difference: 与 vocal 近义，但更强调"直率、不怕得罪人"，语气更硬
synonymComparisons.example: vocal 可以只是"积极发声"，outspoken 往往有"鲁莽直言"的暗示

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调"有口才、表达流畅优雅"，不强调态度
synonymComparisons.example: An eloquent speaker may not be vocal on social issues.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调"条理清楚、表达精准"
synonymComparisons.example: She is articulate in meetings, but not particularly vocal about company politics.

synonymComparisons.difference: 贬义，"尖锐刺耳、咄咄逼人"
synonymComparisons.example: vocal 偏中性/褒义（敢说），strident 是贬义（说得太吵太难听）

oneLinePenetration: vocal 是"让沉默停止的决定"——把心里的声音放到空气里，无论是用声带还是用勇气。

forms.note: 业余爱好（与 vocation 相对）

coreImage: 一个医生凌晨三点被叫到医院，疲惫不堪，但当病人好转时他感到一种"再累也值得"的充实——这就是 vocation。vocation 不是普通的 job，不是用时间换钱，而是一种"被召唤"的感觉：你感觉这件事非你做不可，它不是你的谋生手段，而是你存在于世的方式。这个词的拉丁词根 vocare 本意就是"召唤"，和 voice 同源——就像有一个声音在叫你去做那件只有你能做的事。

semanticRadii.label: 职业类别
semanticRadii.structure: n. (a vocation in, enter a vocation)
semanticRadii.example: Nursing is as much a vocation as it is a profession.

semanticRadii.label: 职业教育
semanticRadii.example: Vocational training programs help students develop practical job skills.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 常用搭配：have a vocation for（有做...的天赋/使命）、find one's vocation（找到自己的使命）、miss one's vocation（入错行）、a sense of vocation（使命感）。形容词 vocational 几乎专用于 vocational training/education/school。注意与 vacation 拼写区分，二者发音也不同。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Teaching is not just a job for her; it's a vocation she discovered at university.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: job vs. vocation 的经典对比："工作"与"使命"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He missed his vocation — he should have been a chef, not a banker.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: miss one's vocation 是固定表达"入错行/选错行"，较正式。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The government is expanding vocational education to address the skills gap.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: vocational education "职业教育"，是形容词用法的主要语境。

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调需要专业训练和资质的职业（医生、律师等）
synonymComparisons.example: Medicine is both a profession and, for many, a vocation.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调职业发展路径，中性客观，无使命感
synonymComparisons.example: A career can be just a series of jobs; a vocation feels like a calling.

synonymComparisons.difference: 中性词，泛指任何职业/工作，最干最无色彩
synonymComparisons.example: Your occupation is what fills your tax form; your vocation is what fills your soul.

synonymComparisons.difference: 与 vocation 最接近，同指"天职/召唤"，但 calling 更口语化
synonymComparisons.example: Teaching is her calling — or, as she puts it more formally, her vocation.

oneLinePenetration: vocation 是一个声音叫你去做的、用一生来回答的那件事——不是"我做什么"，而是"我是什么"。

coreImage: 宇航员飘在飞船外，面前是一望无际的 dark void——没有声音、没有参照物、没有任何东西。这就是 void 最原始的图景：彻底的、绝对的"无"。这份"无"从物理空间蔓延到情感世界——亲人去世后心里的那个空洞；也进入法律领域——合同被判 void，如同从未存在过。void 的对立面不是 full，而是 existence。

semanticRadii.label: 情感缺失
semanticRadii.example: His death left a void in her life that nothing could fill.

semanticRadii.label: 法律无效
semanticRadii.example: The contract was declared null and void by the court.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: 名词用法：fill a/the void（填补空缺/空虚），leave a void（留下空洞），stare into the void（凝视虚空/深渊）。形容词用法：be void of（缺乏、没有），null and void（法律上完全无效，固定搭配不可拆分）。动词用法：void a contract/vote/check（使无效/排放）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: After her children left for college, the house felt like an echoing void.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: void 形容"空荡的感觉"，比 emptiness 更有画面感和虚无意味。

exampleDiagnoses.example: His argument was completely void of logic and evidence.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: be void of "缺乏...的"，是正式的否定表达，等于 completely without。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The judge ruled that the agreement was obtained through fraud and therefore void.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: void 作形容词"无效"，常用于法律语境，不可用 empty 替代。

synonymComparisons.difference: 情感/空间上空洞，日常用语，语气弱于 void
synonymComparisons.example: The room had an air of emptiness, but the void in his heart was far deeper.

synonymComparisons.difference: 物理真空，也引申为"权力/领导真空"
synonymComparisons.example: void 是宇宙级的空，vacuum 是物理学/政治学级的空（power vacuum vs. the void of space）

synonymComparisons.difference: 表面空白（纸、屏幕、表情），不是立体空间
synonymComparisons.example: vacuum 和 void 是三维的"空"；blank 是二维的"空白"。

synonymComparisons.difference: 专用于法律/编程领域，常与 void 连用（null and void）
synonymComparisons.example: The marriage was declared null and void — both legal terms reinforcing each other.

oneLinePenetration: void 是"存在的缺席"——在物理空间是绝对真空，在感情世界是无法填补的空洞，在法律领域是从未发生。

posNote: 易变的；动荡的；易挥发的

forms.note: 易变的；动荡的；易挥发的

coreImage: 一瓶汽油拧开盖子，刺鼻的气味立刻弥漫——它在常温下就在变成气体，随时可以被一根火柴点燃。这就是 volatile 的化学来源：容易变成气体，容易爆炸。这个词从化学走进了金融（volatile stock market 暴涨暴跌）、走进了政治（a volatile region 一点就着）、走进了人际关系（a volatile temper 翻脸比翻书快）。volatile 的共同画面是：稳定只是暂时的，下一秒可能就炸了。

semanticRadii.label: 市场波动
semanticRadii.example: Investors are pulling out of the volatile emerging markets.

semanticRadii.label: 情绪/局势
semanticRadii.example: The peace talks collapsed amid an already volatile political climate.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 常用搭配：a highly volatile situation/market/compound, politically/financially volatile。修饰抽象名词：volatile temper, volatile relationship, volatile political climate。副词形式 volatility 常用于经济语境（market volatility, price volatility）。注意 volatile 不用于形容"犹豫不决"的人。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The stock has been extremely volatile this week, swinging by double digits daily.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: volatile 形容股价"剧烈波动"，是金融市场最核心的描述词之一。

exampleDiagnoses.example: His volatile temper made him difficult to work with, even for his closest colleagues.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: volatile temper "反复无常的脾气"，强调突然性和不可预测性。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The region remains volatile, with sporadic violence breaking out without warning.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: volatile 形容地区局势"动荡不安"，暗示随时可能爆发冲突。

synonymComparisons.difference: 泛指不稳定，涵盖面更宽，无"爆炸性"暗示
synonymComparisons.example: A volatile market crashes suddenly; an unstable one just wobbles unpredictably.

synonymComparisons.difference: 专指人/情绪的多变无常，不用于化学/市场
synonymComparisons.example: He is fickle in love, but the stock market is volatile.

synonymComparisons.difference: 侧重"爆发性强烈"，可指脾气、局势或化学性质
synonymComparisons.example: An explosive temper and a volatile temper are similar, but explosive suggests a single blast while volatile suggests ongoing unpredictability.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调"来回波动"，偏中性描述数据变化
synonymComparisons.example: Oil prices have been fluctuating, but the volatile geopolitical situation could cause a spike at any moment.

oneLinePenetration: volatile 是"稳定状态的叛徒"——它不是没有规律，而是规律随时可能被打破。

posNote: 体积；容量；音量；卷/册；数量

forms.note: 体积；容量；音量；卷/册；数量

coreImage: 一只手转动音箱旋钮，音乐从细若蚊鸣变成震耳欲聋——volume 的第一层是"声响的大小"。同一只手拿起书架上一套百科全书的第一卷（Volume I），翻开后是密集的纸张——volume 的第二层是"册"。再把视线从书架移向仓库，堆满了箱子，物流经理正在计算今天的 cargo volume——volume 的第三层是"数量/容积"。同一个词，从声音到书本到空间，全部指向"量"的多维表达。

semanticRadii.label: 数量统计
semanticRadii.example: The sheer volume of applications overwhelmed the admissions office.

semanticRadii.label: 声音强度
semanticRadii.example: Can you turn down the volume? The neighbors are complaining.

semanticRadii.label: 书籍出版
semanticRadii.structure: n. (Volume I, a volume of poetry)
semanticRadii.example: The encyclopedia consists of 30 volumes covering every topic imaginable.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: 空间/数量义：常用 the volume of sth, sheer volume, high/low volume, sales/traffic/trading volume。声音义：常用 turn up/down the volume, at full volume, volume control。书籍义：常用 Volume I/II/III, a volume of poems/essays。注意：volume 表示"大量"时常用 sheer 加强语气（the sheer volume of work）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The trading volume on the stock exchange hit a record high yesterday.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: trading volume "交易量"，是金融领域的核心指标之一。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She kept the volume low so as not to wake the baby, but the sheer volume of notifications kept buzzing.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 同一句中两个 volume 含义不同：音量 vs. 数量，展现了词义的跨度。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The first volume of her memoirs sold over a million copies worldwide.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: first volume "第一卷"，是出版行业的经典用法。

synonymComparisons.difference: 侧重"容纳能力/最大容量"，不指实际体积
synonymComparisons.example: The tank has a capacity of 500 liters, but the volume of water currently inside is only 200.

synonymComparisons.difference: 泛指数量的"多少"，用于不可数名词
synonymComparisons.example: The amount of work is large, but the volume of data we need to process is even larger.

synonymComparisons.difference: 常用于可数物品的数量，用于可数名词
synonymComparisons.example: The quantity of books vs. the volume of knowledge — you can count books but not knowledge.

synonymComparisons.difference: 特指"大部头的书"，文学作品用词
synonymComparisons.example: He pulled a dusty tome from the shelf — Volume VII of a forgotten encyclopedia.

oneLinePenetration: volume 是"量"的多棱镜——空间里的体积、耳朵里的响度、书架上的册数、报表上的数字，全部是同一个东西的不同切面。

forms.note: 自愿做；主动提供；志愿参军

coreImage: 老师问"谁愿意去搬书？"，全班沉默，一只手举了起来——这只手的主人就是一个 volunteer。volunteer 的核心不是"免费"，不是"高尚"，而是"在没有人点名的情况下自己站起来"。它可以是战场上主动报名参军，可以是医院里义务帮忙，也可以是会议上没人想接的活儿。volunteer 的反义词不是 paid，而是 drafted——不是被征召，被点名，被迫。

semanticRadii.label: 自愿提供
semanticRadii.example: He volunteered to drive everyone to the airport.

semanticRadii.label: 主动提供信息
semanticRadii.example: She didn't wait to be asked and volunteered the information herself.

semanticRadii.label: 自愿参军
semanticRadii.example: He volunteered for military service the day after war was declared.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 名词：a volunteer for sth, a team of volunteers。动词常用结构：volunteer to do sth（自愿做某事），volunteer for sth（自愿承担），volunteer sth（主动提供某事，尤其是信息或帮助）。注意：volunteer to do 语气中性，不必然带有"牺牲"或"奉献"的崇高感，日常可用。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She volunteers at the animal shelter every Saturday morning.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 不及物用法，volunteer at + 地点，表示"在...做志愿者"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Can I volunteer a suggestion before we make the final decision?
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: volunteer a suggestion "主动提个建议"，使用委婉的 Can I... 句式显得礼貌。

exampleDiagnoses.example: No one volunteered for the night shift, so the manager had to assign it.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: volunteered for sth "自愿承担"，否定形式展现真实职场语境。

synonymComparisons.difference: 主动提出给予/做，但不一定有"自愿承担持续责任"的意味
synonymComparisons.example: He offered to help, but she actually volunteered for the entire project.

synonymComparisons.difference: 专指"参军入伍"，是正式的 military enrollment
synonymComparisons.example: A volunteer enlists out of choice; a conscript enlists because the law demands it.

synonymComparisons.difference: 实习生，有工资或用经验换学分，不等同于 volunteer
synonymComparisons.example: An intern may receive course credit; a volunteer receives nothing but satisfaction.

synonymComparisons.difference: 捐钱/捐物/献血，单向给予不涉及持续服务
synonymComparisons.example: She donates blood regularly but doesn't have time to volunteer at the hospital.

oneLinePenetration: volunteer 是一个人主动向前迈出的那一步——不是被推，不是被迫，是你自己说："我来。"

coreImage: 一艘帆船离开港口，海岸线越来越细，最后变成一条线，消失在弧形的海平面上——从这一刻起，你真正踏上了 voyage。voyage 不是 trip（短途），不是 journey（广义旅程），而是"长时间的水上或太空航行"。它暗示着孤独、未知和不可回头：人在茫茫大海上，没有路标，只有星星。麦哲伦的航海、阿波罗的登月，都在人类集体记忆里刻下了 voyage 这个词的壮阔底色。

semanticRadii.label: 太空旅行
semanticRadii.example: The Voyager spacecraft continues its epic voyage beyond the solar system.

semanticRadii.label: 人生隐喻
semanticRadii.example: College was a voyage of self-discovery that changed everything she believed.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 常用搭配：set out on a voyage, embark on a voyage, a long and perilous voyage, maiden voyage（首航）, voyage of discovery/exploration（发现/探索之旅）, bon voyage（祝一路顺风，法语借词）。注意：voyage 几乎专指海上或太空航行，不说 a voyage by car/train/bus。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The crew embarked on a three-month voyage across the Pacific, encountering storms and calm alike.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: embarked on a voyage "踏上航程"，是 voyage 最经典的开场搭配。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Bon voyage! Send us a postcard when you reach the Caribbean.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: Bon voyage 是固定祝福语，"祝旅途愉快"，此处是航海度假语境。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Writing this novel has been a long and solitary voyage into the depths of my own memory.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: voyage 比喻义"深入记忆的航行"，将创作过程比作海上探索。

synonymComparisons.difference: 最广义的旅行，不限交通工具和距离
synonymComparisons.example: A bus journey across town vs. a sea voyage across the ocean.

synonymComparisons.difference: 短途往返旅行，强调"去并回来"
synonymComparisons.example: A weekend trip to the beach is not a voyage, no matter how much fun you had.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调舒适、娱乐性的海上巡游
synonymComparisons.example: voyage 可以是艰辛的探索，cruise 是轻松的海上度假。

synonymComparisons.difference: 有明确目的的探险/考察，不限于海上
synonymComparisons.example: A scientific expedition to the Arctic vs. a solo voyage around the world.

oneLinePenetration: voyage 是把自己交给大海或星空的长路——不是去看风景，而是去触碰世界的边缘。

posNote: 脆弱的；易受伤害的；易受攻击的

forms.note: 脆弱的；易受伤害的；易受攻击的
脆弱性；弱点；易受伤之处
不受伤害的；刀枪不入的

coreImage: 你脱掉盔甲，放下盾牌，站在空旷处——你知道箭矢可以从任何方向射来。这不是软弱，是暴露。像婴儿向着世界张开双臂，像分手后第一次说"我需要你"。vulnerable的悖论：你越敞开，越可能受伤；但你不敞开，你永远不会被真正看见。

semanticRadii.label: 安全威胁
semanticRadii.example: The system is vulnerable to cyber attacks.

semanticRadii.label: 群体脆弱
semanticRadii.example: The elderly are among the most vulnerable during heat waves.

semanticRadii.label: 经济/金融
semanticRadii.example: Small businesses are particularly vulnerable to interest rate changes.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: be vulnerable to sth：脆弱于…（to是介词，后接名词或动名词）。make/leave sb vulnerable to sth：使某人易受…。程度修饰：acutely, particularly, extremely, emotionally, financially。固定搭配：the vulnerable = 弱势群体（集合名词，用作复数）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Children in conflict zones are acutely vulnerable to malnutrition and disease.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 人道主义场景——脆弱=真实的生命危险。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The most powerful leaders are those who can admit vulnerability without losing authority.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 领导力悖论——示弱反而是力量的证明。

synonymComparisons.difference: 暴露在伤害可能中，但不一定已经受伤
synonymComparisons.example: She felt vulnerable walking home alone at night.

synonymComparisons.difference: 本质易碎、需要小心对待（物理/情感）
synonymComparisons.example: The glass figurine is extremely fragile.

synonymComparisons.difference: 对刺激反应强烈（不一定是伤害）
synonymComparisons.example: My skin is sensitive to this detergent.

synonymComparisons.difference: 天生/倾向性地容易受到（偏体质/概率）
synonymComparisons.example: Older people are more susceptible to the virus.

oneLinePenetration: vulnerable描述的不是伤疤，而是"无防护的皮肤"。它是一种状态：你可被触摸、可被伤害、也可被治愈。它的拉丁词根vulnus就是"伤口"。勇敢(brave)不是没有vulnerability——勇敢是"知道会痛，还是选择暴露"。这就是为什么vulnerability是真正的勇气，不是弱点。

coreImage: 一个工人每周五领到一个信封，里面的钱就是他这一周用体力和时间换来的 wages。wage 的数字很具体——按小时或按天算，干多少拿多少。但 wage 还有另一张脸：wage war（发动战争）、wage a campaign（开展运动）——从"领取报酬"跳跃到"主动出击"。这两种看似无关的含义共享一个意象：一场持续的、有代价的投入，无论是用劳动换钱还是用资源换胜负。

semanticRadii.label: 发动/开展
semanticRadii.example: The organization has been waging a campaign against child labor for decades.

semanticRadii.label: 代价/后果
semanticRadii.meaning: 报应；代价（文学/圣经用语）
semanticRadii.example: The wages of sin is death — a line from the Bible that transcends religion.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 名词常用复数 wages（但他的工资很低：His wages are low.）。注意区分 wage vs. salary：wage 通常按时薪/周薪支付给体力劳动者；salary 通常按月/年支付给专业人员。动词搭配：wage war (against/on), wage a campaign/battle/struggle。the wages of sin 是固定圣经引用，不用于日常口语。

exampleDiagnoses.example: With a minimum wage of $15 an hour, many families still struggle to make ends meet.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: minimum wage "最低工资"，是社会经济话题的高频词汇。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The rebels have been waging a guerrilla war against the government for over a decade.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: wage a war "发动/进行战争"，是 wage 动词义的最高频搭配。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She works two jobs for low wages, yet somehow still manages to send money home.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: low wages "低薪"，wages 复数形式突出"多份工"的辛苦。

synonymComparisons.difference: 按月/年支付给专业人员的固定薪水
synonymComparisons.example: His salary is $60,000 a year; her wages come to about $15 an hour.

synonymComparisons.difference: 总收入，包括工资/投资/租金等所有来源
synonymComparisons.example: Your wages are just one part of your total income.

synonymComparisons.difference: 总收入，包括工资/投资/租金等所有来源
synonymComparisons.example: Your wages are just one part of your total income.

synonymComparisons.difference: 赚取的收入，概括性用词
synonymComparisons.example: The company's earnings are up, but workers' wages have barely increased.

synonymComparisons.difference: "发起/启动"，比 wage 更侧重开始的一瞬间而非持续投入
synonymComparisons.example: They launched the campaign in January and have been waging it relentlessly ever since.

oneLinePenetration: wage 的两种含义共享同一个逻辑——用持续的投入换取结果，无论你付出的是汗水还是炮火。

coreImage: 一个人在陌生的城市小巷里没有目的地走，不是为了到什么地方，仅仅是为了"走"本身。这就是 wander——没有地图，没有目的地，让脚替脑子做决定。wander 不是迷路（get lost），因为你不在乎"正确路径"；也不是徒步（hike），因为运动量不是目的。它从脚步的漫游延伸到思绪的游离：你在会议上眼神空洞，心思已经 wanders 到了周末的海边。wander 的美感在于"失控的自由"。

semanticRadii.label: 走神/跑题
semanticRadii.example: I tried to focus on the lecture, but my mind kept wandering.

semanticRadii.label: 偏离原路
semanticRadii.example: The child wandered away from his parents in the crowded market.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: 常用搭配：wander around/through/about（漫游于...），wander off（走散/走丢了），wander from（偏离）。与思维相关：my mind wandered, let your thoughts wander, wander off the point/topic。注意：wander 暗示无目的性和放松感，因此不能用于"匆匆赶路"或"精准定位"的语境。

exampleDiagnoses.example: We had no particular plan — just wandered from café to café along the Seine.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: wander from A to B "在...之间闲逛"，强调随意性。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Halfway through the budget report, my attention wandered to the clock on the wall.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: attention wandered "注意力游离"，经典办公室场景。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The hiker wandered off the trail and had to be rescued by a search team.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: wander off "偏离/走散"，此处有危险意味，不是浪漫的漫步。

synonymComparisons.difference: 与 wander 近义，但 roam 通常范围更大更自由
synonymComparisons.example: Buffalo roam the plains; tourists wander the streets.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调"悠闲散步"，速度慢且有享受感
synonymComparisons.example: wander 可以焦虑，stroll 永远是悠闲的（stroll along the beach vs. wander aimlessly）

synonymComparisons.difference: 渐行渐远，侧重"被力推动"，不限于行走
synonymComparisons.example: A boat drifts with the current; thoughts drift away from a boring lecture.

synonymComparisons.difference: 偏离正确/安全路径，常带负面暗示
synonymComparisons.example: A sheep strays from the flock; a mind wanders from the subject.

oneLinePenetration: wander 是"目的地消失后的移动"——脚在走但不需要到任何地方，心在想但不需要得出任何结论。

posNote: 搜查令/逮捕令；正当理由

forms.note: 搜查令/逮捕令；正当理由
不必要的；无正当理由的

coreImage: 警察敲你的门——不是随便敲的，他手里有张纸，法官签过字。那张纸就是warrant：来自更高权威的"你可以这么做"的书面许可。但你不需要警察才能理解——你在决定花一大笔钱时，心里也在问自己："这笔花费warranted吗？我的理由站得住脚吗？"warrant是介于冲动和行动之间的那个"理由过滤器"。

semanticRadii.label: 必要性动词
semanticRadii.example: The situation warrants immediate intervention.

semanticRadii.label: 担保动词
semanticRadii.example: The manufacturer warrants that the product is free of defects.

semanticRadii.label: 否定形式
semanticRadii.meaning: 无正当理由的侵扰/干涉
semanticRadii.example: The media's intrusion was entirely unwarranted.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: 名词：issue/obtain/execute/withdraw a warrant。动词+warrant：warrant attention/concern/mention/investigation/action。动词接从句：warrant that…（正式担保）。常见否定：sth does not warrant…，unwarranted + 名词。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The judge issued a warrant for his arrest after he failed to appear in court.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 标准法律英文——继发性的逮捕令。

exampleDiagnoses.example: This discovery warrants a complete re-evaluation of our original hypothesis.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 科学场景——一个发现撬动整个框架。

synonymComparisons.difference: 因其性质/严重性而"值得"采取行动
synonymComparisons.example: The damage doesn't warrant a full replacement.

synonymComparisons.difference: 为之辩护、给出理由证明是对的
synonymComparisons.example: How do you justify spending that much on a watch?

synonymComparisons.difference: 因本身具有价值/优点而值得
synonymComparisons.example: Her proposal merits serious consideration.

synonymComparisons.difference: 担保结果一定会发生或产品一定没问题
synonymComparisons.example: I guarantee you'll love this book or your money back.

oneLinePenetration: warrant作名词时，是"纸面上的权力"——权力被文字具象化、被签字认证。作动词时，是"配得上某种反应"——你的愤怒、担忧、行动，需要一个对应体量的理由。unwarranted是最犀利的批评：你不是错了——你是连做这件事的理由都不成立。

coreImage: 凌晨两点，连续加班第四天，你盯着电脑屏幕，眼睛酸涩，脑子里一片混沌——这不只是 tired，而是 weary。tired 睡一觉就能恢复；weary 是一种"渗透到骨头里的、积攒了很久的疲惫"，不一定来自体力，更多来自精神透支、重复劳动和看不到尽头的等待。weary 也有"厌倦"的意味：weary of politics, weary of hearing the same excuses。它是 tired 的加长升级版——不是没电了，是电池老化了。

semanticRadii.label: 厌倦/腻烦
semanticRadii.example: The public has grown weary of politicians making promises they never keep.

semanticRadii.label: 使人疲倦
semanticRadii.example: The endless paperwork soon wearied even the most enthusiastic new employee.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: 形容词用法：weary + 身体部位（weary eyes/legs/mind/smile），feel/look weary。weary of sth 表示"对...感到厌倦"（I am weary of this endless debate）。动词用法（较少见）：sth wearies sb, weary of doing sth。注意：weary 表示的是"长期积累的疲倦"，不用于描述"刚刚运动完的累"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She gave a weary sigh and continued grading the stack of papers on her desk.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: weary sigh "疲惫的叹息"，比 tired sigh 更有"积劳成疾"的深度。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He had grown weary of the corporate rat race and decided to retire early.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: grown weary of "逐渐厌倦"，强调从忍耐到无法忍耐的过程。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The long winter had wearied the entire village, and spring couldn't come soon enough.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: had wearied 作及物动词"使...疲惫"，主语为抽象事物。

synonymComparisons.difference: 一般疲倦，可恢复的，不含有厌倦义
synonymComparisons.example: I'm tired after the gym, but I'm weary of this never-ending project.

synonymComparisons.difference: 完全耗尽，极端疲惫，比 weary 更强烈
synonymComparisons.example: After the marathon, I was exhausted — not just weary, but unable to move.

synonymComparisons.difference: 正式/医学用语，强调功能性疲劳
synonymComparisons.example: Patients reported feeling fatigued — a clinical term that goes beyond everyday weariness.

synonymComparisons.difference: 因经历太多而变得麻木/不再热情，侧重态度非体力
synonymComparisons.example: After years in the music industry, he became jaded and cynical, not just weary.

oneLinePenetration: weary 是"被时间磨损后的疲倦"——不是刚跑完步的累，而是走了太久太久之后，连累都懒得说的那种累。

coreImage: 外婆坐在老式织布机前，梭子来回穿梭，经线纬线在手指间交错，一条布慢慢成形。weave的核心就是"把独立的东西交叠成一个整体"——不只是织布，还有编故事、在车流中穿行。它不追求速度，追求的是节奏和秩序。像蜘蛛织网，一根一根丝，最终成一个完美的几何——每一根都知道自己在整体中的位置。

semanticRadii.label: 编造故事
semanticRadii.meaning: 穿插元素构成完整叙事
semanticRadii.example: She weaves historical facts with personal anecdotes to create compelling essays.

semanticRadii.label: 迂回穿行
semanticRadii.example: The cyclist weaved expertly through the congested streets.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 及物（编织/编造）：weave sth, weave A into B, weave sth from sth。不及物（穿行）：weave through/across/between。固定短语：weave a spell（施咒/迷住），weave one's way through（曲折通过）。weave together把零散元素融合为一个有机整体——极常用。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She weaved her way through the crowded market, never breaking stride.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 空间穿行——像鱼穿过珊瑚礁，不碰不撞。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The old fisherman sat by the river, weaving a net with the same patience his father had taught him.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 技艺传承——编织不只是手艺，是时间的形状。

synonymComparisons.difference: 交叉交叠、经纬交错（物理/抽象均可）
synonymComparisons.example: She weaves silk into intricate patterns.

synonymComparisons.difference: 三股以上编辫子（头发/绳子）
synonymComparisons.example: She braided her daughter's hair before school.

synonymComparisons.difference: 用两根针编织（毛衣/围巾）
synonymComparisons.example: Grandma knitted me a sweater for winter.

synonymComparisons.difference: 缠绕交织（侧重纠缠/难分难解）
synonymComparisons.example: Their fates were intertwined from the moment they met.

oneLinePenetration: weave的古老根义是"移动"——梭子在经纬间移动，使孤立的线变成不可分割的布。人生亦如此：你编织的不是一件毛衣，而是一种秩序，一种让分散事物变得有意义的秩序。

coreImage: 你把门卡住用的那个三角木块——一头薄一头厚，塞进门缝，门就再也关不上了。wedge的本质是"利用斜面的力量，强行制造分离或固定"。它不是正面冲击，是从缝隙里渗透、慢慢撑开、最终让稳固的东西裂开。一把楔子可以劈开巨石——不是因为它比石头硬，而是因为它找到了裂缝，并且不给裂缝任何愈合的机会。

semanticRadii.label: 挤入空间
semanticRadii.example: We managed to wedge ourselves into the crowded subway car.

semanticRadii.label: 离间/制造裂痕
semanticRadii.example: The disagreement began to wedge between the two old friends.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 名词：a wedge of cake/cheese（楔形的一块），drive a wedge between A and B（离间）。动词：wedge sth + adj（wedge the door open），wedge sth between/into/under。被动语态：be wedged in/between（被卡在…）。thin end of the wedge（不好的开端，得寸进尺的第一步）——英式短语。

exampleDiagnoses.example: A small misunderstanding, left unresolved, can drive a wedge between even the closest of friends.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 关系离间——楔子不是仇恨，是没解开的误会。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The earthquake had wedged a massive boulder between the two cliffs, creating a natural bridge.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 地质奇观——大自然也用楔子的逻辑塑造地貌。

synonymComparisons.difference: 楔形物强行插入（物理+比喻）
synonymComparisons.example: She wedged the chair under the doorknob.

synonymComparisons.difference: 强行塞入/卡住（不一定楔形，侧重困住）
synonymComparisons.example: The printer is jammed again.

synonymComparisons.difference: 塞进过多东西（侧重拥挤/超载）
synonymComparisons.example: He crammed his notes into his backpack.

synonymComparisons.difference: 嵌入/卡住（意外/顽固卡住）
synonymComparisons.example: A fish bone lodged in his throat.

oneLinePenetration: wedge的威力不在蛮力在角度——找对那条缝，用对的斜面，你以为坚不可摧的东西，就会无声无息地裂开。一把好楔子从来不需要多大，它只需要比别人更懂得在哪里用力。

forms.note: 福利主义的；福利主义者

coreImage: 一个社会为最脆弱的成员铺的一张安全网——你失业时有救济金，生病时有医保，老了有养老金。welfare不是一个冷冰冰的制度名称，它的根是well + fare——"过得好"。它背后是一个古老的问题：当一个人掉队了，我们是回头拉他一把，还是继续往前走？welfare就是那个回头的动作，是文明社会的标志。

semanticRadii.label: 社会福利
semanticRadii.structure: on welfare, welfare state, welfare benefits
semanticRadii.example: After losing his job, he had to go on welfare for six months.

semanticRadii.label: 动物/群体
semanticRadii.example: Cruelty to animals is a serious breach of animal welfare standards.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: 个人福祉（正式/关心语境）：the welfare of the children, concerned about sb's welfare。社会福利制度：welfare benefits/system/state/program，on welfare（领取救济，美语）。复合词：welfare check（福利检查/上门查看安全），social welfare（社会福利），child welfare（儿童福利）。非welfare department（那是福利部门），是Department of Child Welfare。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She called for a welfare check on her elderly neighbor, who hadn't been seen in three days.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 具体场景——welfare check是美国的社区安全机制。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The company's commitment to employee welfare went beyond salary — it included mental health support and flexible hours.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 职场福利——welfare不只是政府的，也是企业的良心。

synonymComparisons.difference: 健康+幸福+基本保障（个人或制度）
synonymComparisons.example: The state provides welfare for those in need.

synonymComparisons.difference: 身心健康状态（主观感受）
synonymComparisons.example: public yoga classes promote both physical and mental well-being.

synonymComparisons.difference: 经济繁荣和成功
synonymComparisons.example: The postwar years brought unprecedented prosperity.

synonymComparisons.difference: 慈善/施舍（自愿给予，非制度性）
synonymComparisons.example: They rely on charity to feed the homeless.

oneLinePenetration: welfare不是施舍，是承认每一个人都有过得好（fare well）的权利。当你说"我关心你的welfare"时，你说的不是"我给你钱"，而是"我在意你是否安好"。

coreImage: 一扇写着"通过此门进入"的门——whereby就是那扇门上的标志。它不制造新信息，它只是在两个事物之间画一个箭头："A → B，A是实现B的通道"。合同、法律文书、学术论文最爱用它，因为它像一把锁，把条件和结果牢牢扣在一起，不给任何歧义留空间。普通对话中几乎不出现——它是书面语里的"逻辑铰链"。

semanticRadii.label: 法律/条约
semanticRadii.example: They signed a treaty whereby both nations agreed to reduce emissions by 30%.

semanticRadii.label: 关系代词
semanticRadii.example: This is the means whereby the disease is transmitted.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: whereby = by which，引导定语从句，先行词为表示方式/方法/系统/安排的名词。正式写作专用——普通口语中直接换成by which或重新组织句子。常用于：a situation/arrangement/agreement/mechanism/system/process whereby...。注意：whereby本身就包含by的含义，后面不要再用by——不可说whereby by。

exampleDiagnoses.example: They entered into a partnership whereby profits and risks were shared equally.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 合同逻辑——whereby定义了合作的核心规则。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Is there a mechanism whereby ordinary citizens can challenge government decisions?
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 权力制衡——whereby问的是：这条路是否通？

synonymComparisons.difference: 正式书面，"凭借此机制/方法"
synonymComparisons.example: This is the process whereby laws are made.

synonymComparisons.difference: whereby的口语/通用等价形式
synonymComparisons.example: the key by which the door was opened

synonymComparisons.difference: 强调通过...渠道/媒介
synonymComparisons.example: the channel through which information flows

synonymComparisons.difference: "特此/兹"（宣言开头，非关系副词）
synonymComparisons.example: I hereby declare the meeting open.

oneLinePenetration: whereby是"by which"穿上西装打上领带的样子——它唯一的使命就是让方法论听起来更严肃。你不说"a rule by which we decide"，你说"a rule whereby decisions are made"，同样的意思，加倍的分量。

coreImage: 一声脆响划破空气——鞭子末梢在瞬间达到音速，那是人类最早的音爆。whip就是那种"积蓄力量然后瞬间释放"的暴烈美学：抽打、猛拽、快速移动。它不是持续的力，是集中在极短时间内的爆发。从打奶油到政治党鞭，从骑马到金融闪崩，whip总是带着一种不容商量的加速度——准备好了吗？来不及准备了。

semanticRadii.label: 快速移动
semanticRadii.example: He whipped out his phone and took a photo before the bird flew away.

semanticRadii.label: 搅打/打发
semanticRadii.example: Whip the cream until it forms soft peaks.

semanticRadii.label: 政治党鞭
semanticRadii.meaning: 督导议员投票的纪律官员
semanticRadii.example: The chief whip made sure every party member showed up for the vote.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 及物（鞭打/搅打/拽出）：whip sb, whip the horse, whip out a gun。不及物+副词（快速移动）：whip around, whip through, whip past。wind（风）可作主语：The wind whipped through the valley。固定短语：whip up（激起情绪/匆匆做出一顿饭），whip sb into shape（把某人训练好），whip into a frenzy（煽动至狂热）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The politician whipped the crowd into a frenzy with his fiery speech.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 煽动——whip up的变体，情绪被鞭子抽打着狂奔。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He whipped through the report in twenty minutes and caught three major errors.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 快速完成——像鞭子掠过纸张一样快。

synonymComparisons.difference: 鞭打/快速抽动/搅打（速度+力度）
synonymComparisons.example: She whipped the horse to make it run faster.

synonymComparisons.difference: 猛击/猛烈抨击（侧重伤害性）
synonymComparisons.example: The rain lashed against the windows all night.

synonymComparisons.difference: 用鞭/棍用力打（严厉惩罚）
synonymComparisons.example: Prisoners were flogged for minor infractions.

synonymComparisons.difference: 反复击打（日常通用，不一定是鞭子）
synonymComparisons.example: He beat the carpet to get the dust out.

oneLinePenetration: whip的灵魂是"鞭梢效应"——力量从粗柄传到细梢，速度越来越快，最后啪的一声释放。人生里的whip时刻也是如此：你积蓄然后你爆发，快得连自己都还没反应过来。

posNote: 有益健康的；道德良好的

forms.note: 有益健康的；道德良好的

coreImage: 外婆厨房里刚出炉的全麦面包——不花哨，不精致，但那香味让你从头暖到脚。wholesome就是"从根上对你有好处的东西"——不只是食物，也包括人、娱乐、关系。它不是刺激，是滋养；不是速效，是长效。一部wholesome的电影看完让你觉得世界还是好的；一个wholesome的朋友让你想成为更好的人。在糖精和添加剂泛滥的世界里，wholesome是难得的一口天然甜。

semanticRadii.label: 道德良好的
semanticRadii.example: They wanted to make a film their kids could watch — something warm and wholesome.

semanticRadii.label: 人品端正
semanticRadii.example: There's something deeply wholesome about the way he treats everyone with respect.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 修饰名词：wholesome food/entertainment/environment/lifestyle/family values。搭配积极动词：provide wholesome..., need wholesome..., seem/look/appear wholesome。否定：not entirely wholesome, less than wholesome。注意：wholesome ≠ healthy——healthy侧重体检指标正常，wholesome侧重"从内到外都干净、对你只有好处没有坏处"的道德/自然维度。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The film was surprisingly wholesome for a blockbuster — no cynicism, no violence, just heart.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 电影审美——wholesome是稀缺的反套路。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He has a wholesome face that makes strangers trust him instantly.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 面相人品——wholesome可以"长在脸上"。

synonymComparisons.difference: 天然养人+道德干净（内外兼修）
synonymComparisons.example: Grandma's wholesome advice stayed with me for life.

synonymComparisons.difference: 身体/机能层面的"健康"
synonymComparisons.example: Eating vegetables is healthy — eating them with gratitude is wholesome.

synonymComparisons.difference: 有营养的（仅食物）
synonymComparisons.example: Salmon is nutritious, but soup with family is wholesome.

synonymComparisons.difference: 纯净无杂质（不一定含"有益"的意思）
synonymComparisons.example: The snow was pure white, but a wholesome winter morning needs hot cocoa too.

oneLinePenetration: wholesome是"whole"+"some"——像整体一样完整、没有缺失、没有腐败的部分。它不是戒掉垃圾食品，而是天然地偏好那些让你觉得"这样活着真好"的东西。

coreImage: 把一条乡间小路扩成双车道——原来只能过一辆牛车，现在可以双向通车了。widen就是"让边界向外移动"的动作：物理上拓宽道路，比喻上扩大视野、拉大差距。它不创造新东西，它只是让已有的空间更大。但widen也可以用于消极语境——widen the gap, widen the divide——它放大的是距离本身，不管那个距离是好是坏。

semanticRadii.label: 扩大差距
semanticRadii.example: The pandemic has widened the gap between rich and poor.

semanticRadii.label: 扩展范围
semanticRadii.example: The police have widened their search to neighboring counties.

semanticRadii.label: 眼睛睁大
semanticRadii.example: Her eyes widened with disbelief when she heard the news.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 及物：widen + road/gap/scope/horizon。不及物：The road widens, The gap is widening，eyes widen（常用不及物）。widen one's horizons（开阔视野）——经典短语，等同于broaden one's horizons。widen the net（扩大搜捕/搜索范围）。注意widen与broaden区别：widen侧重"宽度维度变大"，broaden可泛指"范围/广度增加"。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The digital divide is widening — those with access to technology surge ahead, the rest fall behind.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 社会议题——widen是差距的放大器。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Traveling alone forced her to widen her perspective on what it means to be independent.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 个人成长——widen的不及物抽象用法。

synonymComparisons.difference: 增加宽度（物理宽度/差距）
synonymComparisons.example: They plan to widen the bridge by two lanes.

synonymComparisons.difference: 扩大范围/广度（经验/视野/知识）
synonymComparisons.example: Reading will broaden your understanding of the world.

synonymComparisons.difference: 全面扩张（规模/体积/业务）
synonymComparisons.example: The company is expanding into Asian markets.

synonymComparisons.difference: 放大尺寸（照片/图像/器官）
synonymComparisons.example: Click here to enlarge the image.

oneLinePenetration: widen的核心是"宽度的移动"——路的宽度，差距的宽度，眼睛睁开的宽度。它不改变事物的本质，它只是让"窄的"变成"宽的"、让"小的"变成"大的"。

coreImage: 一个铁匠握着十几斤重的铁锤——不是随便就能拿起来的，需要力气、技巧和长期训练。wield的核心画面就是"手持重器并实际运用它"——不只是拥有，而是用得上、用得对。一把剑放在架上叫"拥有"，提起来砍出去叫"wield"。权杖如此，笔亦如此——wield power, wield influence, wield a pen like a sword。wield预设了三样东西：重量、能力和杀伤力。

semanticRadii.label: 行使权力
semanticRadii.example: She wields enormous influence behind the scenes, though she holds no official title.

semanticRadii.label: 运用工具
semanticRadii.example: He wields a pen with the same deadly precision as a surgeon wields a scalpel.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: 及物动词：wield + power/influence/authority（抽象权力）或 weapon/sword/axe/tool（物理工具）。wield为主动动词，主语通常是人或机构，装备本身不能wield自己。经典搭配：wield power（行使权力），wield influence（施加影响），wield a pen（以笔为武器），wield considerable clout（有很大影响力）。注意wield预设"用得动"——弱者可have权力，但未必能wield它。

exampleDiagnoses.example: In the right hands, social media can wield a transformative force for good; in the wrong hands, a weapon.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 双刃剑——wield的是工具，决定善恶的是人。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She may look fragile, but she wields a dry, devastating wit that can cut anyone down to size.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 幽默杀伤力——wit也是一种可wield的武器。

synonymComparisons.difference: 手持+有效使用（侧重力气/熟练度）
synonymComparisons.example: He wielded the axe above his head.

synonymComparisons.difference: 挥舞/炫耀式地展示武器（多含威胁）
synonymComparisons.example: The robber brandished a knife at the cashier.

synonymComparisons.difference: 行使权力/权利（正式/制度性）
synonymComparisons.example: Every citizen can exercise their right to vote.

synonymComparisons.difference: 施加（影响力/压力/控制，侧重施力过程）
synonymComparisons.example: The manager exerts constant pressure on her team.

oneLinePenetration: wield的关键不在"有"而在"用"——你可以拥有一把绝世好剑，但如果你挥不动它，你只是在收藏它。wield是一种能力+行动的组合：有胆量拿起来，有本事挥出去。

coreImage: 有人问"谁能帮我把这箱书搬上楼？"，办公室里一片沉默，只有一个人放下手里的咖啡，站起来说"我来"。那个"我来"背后就是willingness——不是能力，不是义务，而是内心主动的许可。willingness不需要你有多强，只需要你愿意。它是最民主的美德：无论贫富智愚，willingness对每个人都开放。高手和小白的分水岭往往不是天赋，是willingness to learn。

semanticRadii.label: 开放心态
semanticRadii.example: What sets great employees apart is their willingness to learn from mistakes.

semanticRadii.label: 协商诚意
semanticRadii.example: Both sides showed a genuine willingness to reach an agreement.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: willingness to do sth（核心结构）：willingness to help/learn/compromise/change/listen。搭配动词：show/demonstrate/express willingness, lack the willingness。搭配形容词：great/genuine/remarkable/complete willingness。注意：willingness是抽象名词不可数——不能说a willingness，但可以说a willingness to do（此处为不定式限定用法）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Despite years of disappointment, he never lost his willingness to trust people.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 善良勇气——被伤过后还愿意信人，willingness是选择而非条件反射。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Her willingness to admit she was wrong, in front of the entire team, earned her more respect than any achievement could.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 领导力——认错的willingness比成功更有威信。

synonymComparisons.difference: 内心主动愿意（态度层面）
synonymComparisons.example: His willingness to help made all the difference.

synonymComparisons.difference: 热切渴望（比willing更强烈）
synonymComparisons.example: She showed great eagerness to start the new project.

synonymComparisons.difference: 准备就绪的状态（愿意+能力就位）
synonymComparisons.example: The troops were in a state of readiness.

synonymComparisons.difference: 不愿意/勉强（willingness的反义词）
synonymComparisons.example: He agreed, but with obvious reluctance.

oneLinePenetration: willingness是心灵的门——你可以敲、可以推、可以要求，但只有主人自己能开。当你发现一个人具备willingness时，你找到的不是能力，是比能力更珍贵的东西：可能性。

coreImage: 黑板擦从左滑到右，粉笔灰飞起来，刚才还满满一黑板的公式和句子，三秒之内消失得像从未存在过。wipe就是那个"用手或布在某表面上施加压力和移动"的动作——擦掉灰尘、擦干眼泪、擦除数据、擦去记忆。它可以温柔如母亲擦去孩子嘴角的饭粒，也可以残酷如一个命令WIPE OUT整个村庄。wipe的本质是：表面还在，但上面写的东西没了。

semanticRadii.label: 数据清除
semanticRadii.example: Make sure to wipe all personal data before selling your old phone.

semanticRadii.label: 彻底消灭
semanticRadii.example: The epidemic wiped out nearly half the population.

semanticRadii.label: 擦除痕迹
semanticRadii.example: Time cannot simply wipe away the pain of losing a child.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: wipe + 表面/污渍：wipe the table, wipe your face, wipe away tears。wipe off（擦掉表面上的东西）：wipe the dust off。wipe out（彻底消灭/精疲力竭）：The disease wiped out the village, I'm completely wiped out（累瘫了）。wipe the slate clean（既往不咎/重新开始）。wipe that smile off your face（把脸上的笑容收起来——别人发怒了）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The virus wiped out decades of economic progress in a matter of months.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 宏观破坏——wipe out是渐进努力的暴力终结者。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He wiped the whiteboard clean, took a deep breath, and said, "Let's start over."
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 仪式感——wipe是"从零开始"的身体语言。

synonymComparisons.difference: 擦+清除（表面痕迹/污渍）
synonymComparisons.example: Wipe your hands on the towel.

synonymComparisons.difference: 擦除（铅笔/黑板/记忆，侧重消失）
synonymComparisons.example: She erased the mistake and wrote the correct answer.

synonymComparisons.difference: 清洁（通用，侧重变干净的过程）
synonymComparisons.example: I need to clean the whole house before the guests arrive.

synonymComparisons.difference: 删除（数字/文本/电子数据）
synonymComparisons.example: Delete all the emails in the spam folder.

oneLinePenetration: wipe是最日常也最暴力的动作之一——擦掉一滴泪和抹去一座城市，用的是同一个词。它的哲学是：一切写在表面上的东西都是暂时的，总有一天会被人擦掉。

coreImage: 两个人在唇枪舌剑，话赶话，正着说反着说，每个回击都比上一击更聪明、更锋利、更好笑。wit就是"语言的刀刃"——不靠音量，不靠蛮力，靠的是在电光火石之间找到那个最意想不到的关联。它是智力的幽默形式，是让严肃变轻松、让攻击变优雅的炼金术。一个真正有wit的人，说话三秒钟能逗笑一桌人，而你说三分钟还在铺垫。

semanticRadii.label: 清醒头脑
semanticRadii.example: In this neighborhood, you need to keep your wits about you after dark.

semanticRadii.label: 思维敏捷
semanticRadii.structure: battle of wits, match wits with sb
semanticRadii.example: The chess match was less a game than a battle of wits.

semanticRadii.label: 才思枯竭
semanticRadii.example: I'm at my wits' end with this child — nothing works!

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: wit作"机智"不可数：have a sharp/quick/dry wit, a man of great wit。复数wits表"头脑/智力"：keep/lose your wits, have the wits to do sth。固定短语：at one's wits' end（束手无策/走投无路），frighten/scare sb out of their wits（吓得魂飞魄散），battle of wits（智力较量），to wit（那就是说——法律用语）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: When the fire alarm went off, everyone panicked — but she kept her wits and calmly led everyone to the exit.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 危机时刻——keep one's wits是危难中最值钱的能力。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The dinner conversation was a lively battle of wits, with puns flying across the table faster than the wine was being poured.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 社交场景——wit让饭桌变成竞技场。

synonymComparisons.difference: 语言幽默+智力敏锐（快且妙）
synonymComparisons.example: Oscar Wilde was celebrated for his razor-sharp wit.

synonymComparisons.difference: 幽默感（更宽泛，含温和/傻气型）
synonymComparisons.example: He has a warm sense of humor that makes everyone comfortable.

synonymComparisons.difference: 智力（无幽默成分）
synonymComparisons.example: High intelligence doesn't always come with wit.

synonymComparisons.difference: 聪明/机灵（可含贬义"小聪明"）
synonymComparisons.example: His cleverness in avoiding work was legendary.

oneLinePenetration: wit是智力在最短时间内的最优表达——它不在乎对不对，只在乎妙不妙。好人让人放心，聪明人让人佩服，但有wit的人让人上瘾。

forms.note: 已撤回(过去分词)/孤僻的

coreImage: 你把脚从已经踩进去的水坑里抽回来——水已经浸湿鞋底了，但你决定不再往前走了。withdraw就是那个"抽回来"的动作：撤回说过的话、从银行取钱、退出比赛、撤军。它的根是with(向后)+draw(拉)——把已经伸出去的东西拉回来。这不是逃跑，是重新评估后的决定。有些withdraw是战略撤退，有些是尊严止损，还有一些是安静的戒断——把依赖过的东西一点一点从身体里抽走。

semanticRadii.label: 撤回/撤销
semanticRadii.example: The company withdrew its offer after the scandal broke.

semanticRadii.label: 撤军
semanticRadii.example: The general ordered his troops to withdraw to safer positions.

semanticRadii.label: 退出/撤退
semanticRadii.example: He was forced to withdraw from the tournament due to injury.

semanticRadii.label: 社交退缩
semanticRadii.example: After the divorce, she withdrew into herself and rarely went out.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 及物（撤回/取出）：withdraw money, withdraw a statement, withdraw troops。不及物（退出/撤退）：withdraw from sth, withdraw to somewhere。withdraw into oneself（自我封闭）。withdraw的名词withdrawal极重要——银行取款、军事撤退、戒毒/药戒断反应（withdrawal symptoms）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The bank froze his account; he couldn't withdraw a single cent of his own money.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 金融困境——withdraw的权利不是理所当然的。

exampleDiagnoses.example: He publicly withdrew his earlier remarks, admitting he had been misinformed and wrong.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 公开道歉——withdraw一个声明需要勇气，但值得尊敬。

synonymComparisons.difference: 撤回/取出/退出（正式，多语境）
synonymComparisons.example: She withdrew her hand from his grasp.

synonymComparisons.difference: 撤退（军事/策略性后退，规避危险）
synonymComparisons.example: The army retreated under cover of darkness.

synonymComparisons.difference: 退出（口语化，突然/果断）
synonymComparisons.example: The sponsor pulled out of the deal at the last minute.

synonymComparisons.difference: 收回（言论/指责/身体部位）
synonymComparisons.example: The newspaper retracted the false story and apologized.

oneLinePenetration: withdraw = with(向后) + draw(拉)——把已经迈出去的那只脚拉回来。撤退不是失败，收手比出手更需要判断力。

forms.note: 已扣留(过去式/过去分词同形)

coreImage: 你伸手要一样东西——信息、认可、工资、真相——对方说"我知道，但我不给你"。withhold就是那个"把手收回来，不给"的动作：扣住信息不说、扣住工资不发、扣住批准不下。它的根是with(向后)+hold(拿着)——你手里有别人想要的东西，但你选择不递出去。这不是没有，是不给。withhold可能是武器，也可能是自卫。

semanticRadii.label: 不付款
semanticRadii.meaning: 拒绝支付(到了该付时不给)
semanticRadii.example: Tenants may withhold rent if the landlord refuses to make essential repairs.

semanticRadii.label: 不给许可
semanticRadii.example: The board withheld its approval until more details were provided.

semanticRadii.label: 情感保留
semanticRadii.example: Growing up, his father withheld praise, believing it would build character.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: 及物动词：withhold + information/payment/consent/approval/affection/support。withhold sth from sb：withhold information from the public, withhold affection from a child。常用被动：information is being withheld, payment was withheld。法律/行政语境高频词：withholding tax（预扣税）。注意：withhold预设你有权/有能力给出该物——你不能"withhold"一件你根本不拥有的东西。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She learned early that he would withhold affection whenever she disagreed with him — a form of emotional blackmail.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 情感操控——withhold是冷暴力的语法。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The judge ruled that the documents had been wrongfully withheld and ordered their immediate release.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 司法胜利——withhold有时是违法的。

synonymComparisons.difference: 有权给但选择不给（扣留/隐瞒）
synonymComparisons.example: The witness withheld a key detail from her testimony.

synonymComparisons.difference: 压制/阻止传播（更强力/系统化）
synonymComparisons.example: The regime suppressed all independent media.

synonymComparisons.difference: 隐藏/遮掩（侧重不让被发现）
synonymComparisons.example: She concealed the letter under her pillow.

synonymComparisons.difference: 保留/持有（中性，不一定是拒绝给）
synonymComparisons.example: The company retains the right to cancel the contract.

oneLinePenetration: withhold = with(向后) + hold(拿住)——手里的东西不递出去。它可以是保护，也是可以是伤害。被withhold最多的是什么呢？不是钱，是信息，是认可，是那句"你做得很好"。

posNote: 承受；经受住；抵抗（压力/攻击等）

forms.note: 承受；经受住；抵抗（压力/攻击等）
已承受(过去式/过去分词同形)

coreImage: 龙卷风过境，那棵老橡树叶子全没了，腰杆还是直的。隔壁的广告牌早飞了，但它还在——不是因为它比风更强，是因为它的根比风更深。withstand不是战斗，是承受。像那堵挡过无数次洪水的堤坝——它没有还手，它只是没有塌。最安静的英雄主义，就是"我还在"。

semanticRadii.label: 精神考验
semanticRadii.example: Her story did not withstand close scrutiny.

semanticRadii.label: 自然灾害
semanticRadii.example: Buildings in the area are designed to withstand major earthquakes.

semanticRadii.label: 攻击/批评
semanticRadii.example: The fortress withstood the siege for six months.

grammarRules.title: 必背搭配
items: withstand + 名词（不用to do）：withstand the pressure, withstand the test of time。情态+withstand：can withstand, be able to withstand, be designed/built to withstand。常见否定：unable to withstand, cannot withstand。固定短语：withstand the test of time（经受时间考验）——最高级褒扬。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The bridge was built to withstand floods, but this one was beyond design.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 工程+极限——设计有上限，但使命无上限。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Could your argument withstand five minutes of serious cross-examination?
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 逻辑攻击——压力测试你的信念。

synonymComparisons.difference: 被动承受、不垮（侧重抗压能力）
synonymComparisons.example: The dam withstood the flood.

synonymComparisons.difference: 主动抵抗、不屈服（侧重对抗意志）
synonymComparisons.example: She resisted the urge to check her phone.

synonymComparisons.difference: 长期忍受、持续存在（侧重时间）
synonymComparisons.example: They endured years of hardship in exile.

synonymComparisons.difference: 容忍（侧重心理/生理接受度）
synonymComparisons.example: I can't tolerate loud chewing.

oneLinePenetration: withstand的with=against，stand=站立——在对抗的力量面前保持站立。它不是"打败"对方，是"不被打败"。最动人的withstand故事不是天生强大，而是裂缝里长出根须——你经受了那些本该摧毁你的事，而你还在。不是毫发无伤，是不倒下。

coreImage: 一场车祸在十字路口发生，五个行人同时抬头，五双眼睛同时记录。witness首先是一个人——"我看到发生了什么"的那个人。法庭上，witness的那句话可以定人生死；历史上，witness的那双眼睛让真相不被湮灭。作动词时，witness是"亲身经历并可以作证"——你看过，所以你欠这个事件一个真实的叙述。不是观众，是证人——带着责任的眼睛。

semanticRadii.label: 现场目击
semanticRadii.example: Several bystanders witnessed the robbery and called the police.

semanticRadii.label: 历史见证
semanticRadii.example: Our generation has witnessed the rise of the internet.

semanticRadii.label: 法律文件
semanticRadii.structure: bear witness to, be a witness to
semanticRadii.example: These ruins bear witness to a once-great civilization.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: 名词：a witness to the accident/crime（目击者），eye witness（目击证人），key/star witness（关键证人），bear witness to sth（为…作证/表明）。动词：witness an event/change/revolution。法庭用语：witness stand（证人席），witness box（英式），hostile witness（敌对证人）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The past century has witnessed technological advances that would have seemed like magic to our ancestors.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 历史视角——世纪是见证者，witness赋予年代拟人感。

exampleDiagnoses.example: These scars bear witness to a childhood no child should have endured.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 悲伤见证——疤痕是不会说话但不会忘记的witness。

synonymComparisons.difference: 亲眼目睹+可以作证（人和事件之间）
synonymComparisons.example: No one witnessed the accident.

synonymComparisons.difference: 观察者（不一定是目击重要事件）
synonymComparisons.example: She was a keen observer of social behavior.

synonymComparisons.difference: 观众/旁观者（看热闹的，无作证责任）
synonymComparisons.example: Thousands of spectators cheered at the parade.

synonymComparisons.difference: 在场的人/路人（可能看到了，但不一定作证）
synonymComparisons.example: Several bystanders recorded the incident on their phones.

oneLinePenetration: witness不只是"看"，是"看到了并且我知道这意味着什么"。作家、记者、历史学家——所有记录时代的人都是witness，他们在替未来保存现在的真相。

coreImage: 一个工厂早上八点，上万个工人骑着自行车从四面八方涌来——穿过大门，打卡，穿上工服，站上流水线。整个城市的正常运转就靠这些背影。workforce就是"所有干活的人的总和"——不是一个一个的张三李四，而是作为一个整体的劳动力池。公司有workforce，城市有workforce，国家有workforce。它是经济的肌肉，没有它，一切计划和愿景都只是纸上谈兵。

semanticRadii.label: 国家劳动力
semanticRadii.meaning: 全国劳动人口/技能型劳动力
semanticRadii.example: A skilled workforce is the backbone of any advanced economy.

semanticRadii.label: 劳动力市场
semanticRadii.example: After graduation, she was eager to join the workforce.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 整体概念通常加定冠词：the workforce。搭配形容词：skilled/unskilled workforce, aging workforce, diverse workforce, entire workforce。搭配动词：reduce/cut/downsize the workforce, expand/train/develop the workforce, enter/leave/rejoin the workforce。workforce是集合名词，谓语用单数：The workforce is...

exampleDiagnoses.example: The pandemic forced companies to rethink what a productive workforce looks like in a remote world.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 职场革命——workforce的物理形态被改变了。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She took ten years off to raise her children, then slowly found her way back into the workforce.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 个人叙事——enter/leave/rejoin workforce是一个人生命的大段落。

synonymComparisons.difference: 劳动力总和（经济/企业视角）
synonymComparisons.example: The workforce needs retraining for the digital age.

synonymComparisons.difference: 员工/职员（具体工作场所的人）
synonymComparisons.example: The hotel staff were extremely helpful.

synonymComparisons.difference: 劳动者阶级（宏观/政治经济学）
synonymComparisons.example: Labor unions fought for better working conditions.

synonymComparisons.difference: 人事/人员（军事/企业正式用语）
synonymComparisons.example: All personnel must attend the safety training.

oneLinePenetration: workforce是经济的心跳——它跳动的速度和节奏决定了企业的生死、城市的繁荣、国家的命运。你是张三，你是李四，但你加入workforce的那一刻，你就成了统计数字里一个不可或缺的1。

coreImage: 傍晚六点，你看着桌上的三份报告、两封待回邮件和明天要演示的PPT——这是你今天的"没做完"。workload不是你做了什么，是你肩膀上扛了多少要去做的事。一个装满了水的桶，再多一滴就会溢出来——workload就是那个桶的承载量。合理的工作量让你保持节奏，过重的workload让你崩溃。它不是时间问题，是容量问题。

semanticRadii.label: 管理分配
semanticRadii.example: We need to find ways to distribute the workload more evenly.

semanticRadii.label: 学术课业
semanticRadii.example: The workload in medical school is notoriously demanding.

grammarRules.title: 用法规则
items: 搭配形容词：heavy/huge/enormous/excessive/crushing workload, manageable/light workload。搭配动词：handle/cope with/manage the workload, reduce/increase/distribute/share the workload。workload + 动词：the workload is overwhelming, the workload has doubled。workload不可数——不说a workload（除非有形容词修饰：a heavy workload）。

exampleDiagnoses.example: She learned to say no — not because she was lazy, but because her workload was already beyond sustainable.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 边界智慧——拒绝不是偷懒，是保护自己不被workload压垮。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The new software cut his daily workload in half, freeing up time for creative thinking.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 效率解放——好工具减轻workload，让脑子有空间呼吸。

synonymComparisons.difference: 一个人/团队的整体工作负担量
synonymComparisons.example: My current workload is unsustainable.

synonymComparisons.difference: 工作流程（事情怎么做的，非多少）
synonymComparisons.example: The new workflow reduced duplicate steps.

synonymComparisons.difference: 负担（负面情感色彩）
synonymComparisons.example: The financial burden of the loan kept him awake at night.

synonymComparisons.difference: 个案数量（医生/社工/律师的待处理案件）
synonymComparisons.example: Each social worker carries a caseload of about forty families.

oneLinePenetration: workload是"work+load"——你的工作扁担上放了多少东西。一根扁担能挑的水是有限的，你的精力也是。尊重workload就是尊重自己不是机器。

coreImage: 一个木匠的工坊——墙上挂满工具，地上铺着刨花，空气里有松木和油漆的味道。workshop的本义是"动手的地方"。后来语义拓展到"动脑子、动手交流的地方"——写作workshop、领导力workshop、戏剧workshop。无论是做木工还是写诗，workshop的灵魂是一样的：一群人围在一起，不是听一个人讲，而是一起做、一起改、一起进步。椅子不重要，黑板不重要，手上有活儿才重要。

semanticRadii.label: 培训研讨会
semanticRadii.example: The university is running a three-day workshop on academic writing.

semanticRadii.label: 创意工作坊
semanticRadii.example: Her short story was workshopped by the entire creative writing class.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: 名词：a workshop on sth（关于...的工作坊），hold/run/conduct/organize a workshop，attend/participate in a workshop。作动词（创意领域）：workshop a script/play/novel（把剧本/小说拿到工作坊让大家提意见修改）。drama workshop, repair workshop, training workshop。

exampleDiagnoses.example: Instead of another PowerPoint lecture, he organized a hands-on workshop where everyone got to practice.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 培训革命——真正的workshop不需要幻灯片，需要动手。

exampleDiagnoses.example: His grandfather's workshop still smelled of oil and sawdust, though no one had set foot in it for years.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 记忆空间——物理workshop是一个人的自我世界。

synonymComparisons.difference: 动手/研讨（参与式，重互动）
synonymComparisons.example: The woodworking workshop was fully booked in a day.

synonymComparisons.difference: 学术研讨会（专家主讲，听众提问）
synonymComparisons.example: She presented her findings at a seminar on climate policy.

synonymComparisons.difference: 工作室（艺术创作空间，非临时）
synonymComparisons.example: The painter invited us to her studio to see the new collection.

synonymComparisons.difference: 工厂（大规模生产，非手工作坊）
synonymComparisons.example: The factory produces 10,000 units a day.

oneLinePenetration: workshop不是教室——教室是"我讲你听"，workshop是"我们一起做，做完了我们一起看哪里可以更好"。真正的workshop里没有老师，只有比你更有经验的同路人。

posNote: 遍及全球的；世界范围的

forms.note: 遍及全球的；世界范围的

coreImage: 你半夜在手机上发布了一段视频，早上醒来发现一个东京的动画师、一个巴西的高中生和一个住在柏林的退休教师都在转发它。worldwide就是"整个地球都算在内"——没有时区边界，没有语言壁垒，没有文化隔阂。互联网让worldwide从梦想变成了日常，但真正能让一样东西worldwide的，不是技术，是它击中了人类共通的某根弦。

semanticRadii.label: 全球声誉
semanticRadii.meaning: 世界范围内的声誉/知名度
semanticRadii.example: The singer gained worldwide recognition after her debut album.

semanticRadii.label: 全球现象
semanticRadii.example: The pandemic became a worldwide health crisis within weeks.

grammarRules.title: 用法说明
items: 形容词：worldwide sales/network/reputation/fame/demand/crisis。副词：be sold/distributed/known/broadcast worldwide。位置灵活：形容词可前置（a worldwide audience）或后置（the audience is worldwide）。同义词globally可互换，但worldwide更有"每个角落"的感觉。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The company's new product launch was a worldwide event, with live streams watched by millions across every continent.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 商业叙事——worldwide意味着太阳永远在某处照着你。

exampleDiagnoses.example: His books have been translated into forty languages and sold worldwide — but he still writes in the same coffee shop he always did.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 反差——worldwide声望 vs. 不变的生活半径。

synonymComparisons.difference: 涵盖全球每个角落（最通用）
synonymComparisons.example: The brand is recognized worldwide.

synonymComparisons.difference: 全球性的/整体的（偏宏观/系统性）
synonymComparisons.example: Global warming affects every ecosystem.

synonymComparisons.difference: 国际间的/多国参与的（国与国之间）
synonymComparisons.example: International trade agreements are being renegotiated.

synonymComparisons.difference: 宇宙性的/普遍适用的（不限于地理位置，真理层面）
synonymComparisons.example: The desire for love is universal.

oneLinePenetration: worldwide不是"很多国家"，是"地球上的每一个角落"。当你做的东西飞出了你的城市、你的语言、你的时区，在你不认识的人那里产生了意义——那一刻，你就是worldwide。

coreImage: 感冒时你觉得喉咙有点疼，心想睡一觉就好了。第二天醒来发现疼得更厉害了，还开始咳嗽，一量体温，38度5——你在看着病情一点点往下滑，那就是worsen。worsen不是"一开始就糟"，是"本来还可以，后来变糟了"。它是一根向下的曲线：经济worsen，关系worsen，病情worsen。它是好状态的倒退——正因为你见过好的样子，所以才更怕那个"更糟了"的趋势。

semanticRadii.label: 经济/政治
semanticRadii.example: Tensions between the two nations continued to worsen.

semanticRadii.label: 天气
semanticRadii.example: The forecast warned that the storm would worsen by evening.

semanticRadii.label: 使…恶化
semanticRadii.example: Ignoring the leak will only worsen the damage to the ceiling.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 不及物（最常见）：things worsen, the situation worsens。及物：sth worsens the condition/situation，worsen matters（固定短语：让事情更糟）。加程度副词：worsen dramatically/significantly/considerably/gradually。常见变体：worsening conditions/crisis/health。worsen是bad→worse→worsen的动词化，自带比较级含义。

exampleDiagnoses.example: The haze worsened throughout the day until the skyline disappeared entirely behind a wall of gray.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 环境叙事——worsen是渐变，不是突变，让人在不知不觉中滑入深渊。

exampleDiagnoses.example: His refusal to apologize only worsened the rift between him and his brother.
exampleDiagnoses.diagnosis: 关系恶化——不道歉是最有效的worsen法宝。

synonymComparisons.difference: 变坏（常用的日常/正式用语）
synonymComparisons.example: The traffic situation has worsened since the new mall opened.

synonymComparisons.difference: 恶化/衰败（偏正式/医学，常指不可逆）
synonymComparisons.example: Her health has deteriorated rapidly over the past few months.

synonymComparisons.difference: 使恶化（及物，加重疾病/局势）
synonymComparisons.example: Smoking will aggravate your respiratory condition.

synonymComparisons.difference: 衰落/下降（长期的/统计性的下滑）
synonymComparisons.example: The city's population has been declining for decades.

oneLinePenetration: worsen不是让你从零开始变坏，而是在你已经有的坏上面再坏一点。那些本来可以挽回的事、本来可以治愈的病、本来可以和好的人——worsen是看着它们的窗口一点一点关闭。

coreImage: 信徒在教堂里跪下，阳光从彩色玻璃窗斜射进来，双手合十，嘴唇在动但没有声音。worship是"把最高的价值放在一个人/一件事身上"——在宗教里是对神的敬拜，在世俗中是"像拜神一样崇拜某人"。粉丝对偶像、员工对乔布斯式创始人、孩子对英雄——worship把对象放大到不需要理由的程度。它既是信仰的力量源泉，也是理性让位的时刻。

semanticRadii.label: 极度崇拜
semanticRadii.example: As a child, he worshipped his older brother and copied everything he did.

semanticRadii.label: 盲目崇拜
semanticRadii.structure: money worship, hero worship, celebrity worship
semanticRadii.meaning: 拜金主义/英雄崇拜/明星崇拜
semanticRadii.example: In a culture of celebrity worship, moral character often takes a back seat.

semanticRadii.label: 做礼拜
semanticRadii.example: The family goes to worship every Sunday without fail.

grammarRules.title: 语法结构
items: 及物：worship God/a leader/celebrities/money/power。不及物（做礼拜）：Where do you worship?。崇拜对象作主语：worship sb for their courage/wisdom/achievements。固定短语：hero worship（英雄崇拜），money worship（拜金主义），place of worship（教堂/寺庙等宗教场所），Your Worship（对市长/法官的尊称，英式）。
